clerkship: CLERKSHIP: I Business of a clerk: लेखकत्वम् (?); लेखकपदम्। II Scholarship: q. v.
clever: CLEVER: (1) चतुरः (रा, रं); (2) विचक्षणः (णा।  णं): v. Skilful, expert.
cleverness: CLEVERNESS: (1) वैचक्षण्थम्; (2) नैपुण्यम्; (3) चातु-र्यम्; (4) वैदग्ध्यम्।: v. Skilfulness, dexterity.
click: CLICK: I Verb: टङ्करोति (?). II Subs.: टङ्कारः।
client: CLIENT: I A dependent: आश्रितः (ता, तं). II In law: *श्रावकः।
clientship: CLIENTSHIP: I Dependency: q. v.: अधीनता। II In law: *श्रावकत्वम्।
cliff: CLIFF: (1) प्रपातः; (2) भृगुः (rare), fall from a c.: भृगुपतनम्, D.
climate: CLIMATE: I Temperature etc.: देशप्रकृतिः (?); वायुतापौ (m. dual) (?). II A region: q. v.: प्रदेशः।
climax: CLIMAX: I Acme: (1) परा कोटिः; (2) चूडा। II In Rhetoric: (1) सारः, Kav. x. 37.; (2) सारालङ्कारः।
climb: CLIMB (v.): अरोहति, अधि- (रुह्। c. 1), (with acc.) to c. up the top of a tree: वृक्षाग्रमारोहति, S. c. Ph.: c. d over the wall: प्राकारमत्यलङ्घयम्, D. iii.; he knows how to c.: स वृक्षाद्यारोढुं जानाति (sim. आरोढुं) (will be ambiguous, as it often means riding.).
climber: CLIMBER: I In gen.: (1) भारोहिन् or अधिरोहिन् (f. णी); (2) आरोढ्ट (f. ढ्री). II A climbing plant: (1) व्रतती; (2) वल्लरी। The supporting tree on which a climber rises: (1) संश्रयद्रुमः, Ku.; (2) उपध्नतरुः, R. III A climbing bird: आरोहिन् (f. णी).
clincher: CLINCHER: i. e. a decisive argument: उप-संहारः।
cling: CLING (v. l.): सज्जते, आ-, प्र-, सं- (सञ्ज्, c. l.), who c. s to my dress: को नु खलु निवसने मे सज्जते, Sa. iv.; with trees c. ing: संसक्तक्षितिरुहजालम्, Vi.; (2) लगति, संलगति (लग्, c. l.), clung to the Śinsapā tree: शिंशपावृक्षे ललाग, Vet.; c. ing to the teeth: दन्तलग्नः (ग्ना, ग्नं), Ku. Ph. c. to a hope: आशां न मुञ्चति, जहाति, etc.
clinical: CLINICAL: Ph. c. medicine: शय्यागतरोगि-चिकित्सा (?), or -शास्त्रम् (?).
clink: CLINK (v.): क्वणति (क्वण्, c. l.): v. To tink--le, jingle.
cloak: CLOAK (subs.): (1) कञ्चुकः, her body covered with a blue c. hanging down to the ankle: आगुल्फावल-म्बिना नीलकञ्चुकेनाच्छन्नशरीराम्, K.; (2) प्रावारः (gen. = blanket or shawl), Mr.
CLOAK (v.): अवगुण्ठयति (गुण्ठ्, c. 10): v. To hide, palliate.
clock: CLOCK: *घटिका; sidereal-c.: *नाक्षत्रघटिका; what o'c. is it? *कियतो घटिका?
cloister: CLOISTER: I A portico: q. v. II A monas--tery: q. v.: विहारः।
close: CLOSE (v. t.): I To shut: q. v.: अपि-दधाति (धा, c. 3), c. the back door: पिधेहि पक्षद्वारकम्, Mr.; to c. the eyes: लोचने मीलयति, नि-, (c. of मोल्), Me. II To bring into contact: संहन्ति (हन्, c. 2). III To conclude, finish: q. v.: समापयति (c. of आप्). IV To confine: q. v. To c. in or round: परिवृणोतिः v. To surround.

CLOSE (v. i.): I To come together: (1) नि-मीलति (मील्, c. l) (of the eye); (2) समा-रोहति (रुह्, c. l) (of wounds).: v. To unite. II To come to an end: expr. by अवसितः (ता, तं), समाप्तः (प्ता, प्तं), etc.; when he c. d: वचस्यवसिते तस्मिन्, Ku.

CLOSE (adj.): I Shut fast: (1) पिहितः (ता,  तं); (2) संवृतः (ता, तं); (3) बद्धः (द्धा, द्धं) (=bound). II Secret, retired: q. v.: विविक्तः (क्ता, क्तं). III Confined, as air: निरुद्धः (द्धा, द्धं). IV Reticent, taciturn: q. v. V. Niggardly: q. v.: बद्धमुष्टि (mfn.). VI Dense, compact: q. v.: घनः (ना, नं). VII Ad--joining, near: q. v.: सन्निहितः (ता, तं), are always c. at hand: हस्ते नित्यसान्निध्यानि, D. VIII Of style: v. Concise. IX Intimate: (1) घनः (ना, नं); (2) निविडः (डा, डं), very c. friendship: निविडतमा मैत्री, Bha. X Accurate, careful: q. v.
CLOSE (adv.): I Densely: q. v. II Near: q. v.: (1) उपान्ते; (2) समीपतः।
CLOSE (subs.): I An enclosure: q. v.: वृतिः। II End, termination: q. v.: अवसानम्, c. of the day: दिवावसानम्, R. III Junction: q. v.
close on or upon: CLOSE ON or UPON: स्थिरीकरोतिः v. Agree, decide.
close up: CLOSE UP: अवृणोति (वृ, c. 5): v. To block up.
close with: CLOSE WITH: I To close on: q. v. II To unite with: q. v. III To grapple with: संगच्छति (गम्, c. 4), समेति (इ, c. 2), etc.
close-fisted: CLOSE-FISTED, CLOSE-HANDED: बद्धमुष्टि (mfn.), your c. ness in giving me a look: दृष्टिदाने तव बद्ध-मुष्टिता, N.
closely: CLOSELY: v. Densely; nearly; strictly; accurately; firmly; secretly.
closeness: CLOSENESS: I Compact: q. v.: घनता। II Nearness: q. v.: नैकट्यम्। III Niggardliness: q. v. IV Of air: निरुद्धवातता। V. Of style: v. Conciseness. VI Narrowness: q. v. VII Accuracy: q. v. VIII Secrecy: q. v.
closet: CLOSET (v.): I To conceal: q. v. II To consult: q. v.
clot: CLOT (v.): (1) पिण्डीभवति; (2) घनीभवति। C. ted hair: जटा, -जूटः।
cloth: CLOTH: I Lit.: (1) वस्त्रम्, coarse c. स्थूलवस्त्रम्, P. ii. 5.; fine c.: सूक्ष्मवस्त्रम्, N. com.; (2) पटः or पट्टः, making of different kinds of c.: अनेक-विधपटरचना, P. ii. 5.: v. Also clothes. II A profession: q. v.
clothe: CLOTHE (v.): I To put on c. s: c. ing her-self: गृहीतवस्त्रा, Ku.; c. ing himself: परिधाय  वाससी, K.: v. To put on clothes. II To invest with raiment: वस्त्रं etc. परिधापयति (c. of धा) or वासयति (c. of वस्). III To pro--vide with c. s: but should feed and c. her: ग्रासाच्छादनन्तु देयमेव, K. b. IV To cover or invest: q. v.
clothes: CLOTHES, CLOTHING: (1) वसनम्, when (her) c. were being drawn off: आकृष्यमाणे वसने, Mah.; (2) वस्त्रम्, taking off c.: वस्त्राणि मोचयित्वा, P.; (3) वासस् (n.), Basantasenā's c. are wet: क्लिन्ने  वाससी वसन्तसेनायाः, Mr.; (4) अंशुकम्; (5) अम्बरम् (rare); (6) परिच्छदः, pretty c. कमनीयपरि-च्छदः, Ki.; (7) परिधानम् (=under-c.), by whom even her c. was taken away: येनास्याः परिधानमप्य-पहृतम्, Ve. N.B. The first five words gen. = a single piece of cloth and their dual is often used to denote a suit of c. as the Hindu's dress consisted only of two pieces of gar--ment: v. Dress.
cloud: CLOUD (subs.): (1) मेघः; (2) जलदः; (3) जल- [Page127] धरः; (4) घनः; (5) पर्जन्यः; (6) अभ्रम्; (7) बला-हकः; (8) जीमूतः; (9) नीरदः; (10) पयोमुच् (m.). C. born: मेध्यः (ध्या, ध्यं); c.-producing: मेघ-ङ्करः (री, रं), Si. xx. 61. and 65.; a long line of c. s: कादम्बिनी, Ku. Fig.: a c. of dust धूलीपटलः; I am under a c. now: साम्प्रतं ममोपरि  शनेर्द्यष्टिः (?).
cloud-capped: CLOUD-CAPPED: (1) अभ्रंलिहः (हा, हं); (2) अभ्रं-कषः (षा, षं); (3) अम्बरलेखिन् (f. नी).
clouded: CLOUDED: I Lit: मेघावृतः (ता, तं); (2) मेघा-च्छन्नः (न्ना, न्नं); (3) घनोपरुद्धः (द्धा, द्धं). II Fig. v. Dark, gloomy, sullen.
cloudless: CLOUDLESS: (1) अमेघः (घा, घं); (2) निरभ्रः (भ्रा,  भ्रं); (3) व्यभ्रः (f. भ्रा), V. p.; (4) वीतबलाहकः (का, कं), Ki.; and sim. comp. s.
cloudy: CLOUDY: I Lit., clouded: q. v.: (1) अम्रितः (ता, तं), R. iii. 12; (2) साभ्रः (f. भ्रा), Me. ii. 29. Ph. c. weather दुर्दिनम्। II Fig., dark, obscure: q. v.: तमोवृतः (ता, तं).
clove: CLOVE: I The plant: लवङ्गः। II The fruit: लवङ्गम्।
cloven: CLOVEN: (1) स्फाटितः (ता, तं); (2) दीर्णः, वि-, (र्णा, र्णं); (3) खण्डितः (ता, तं). C.-hoofed: द्विशफः (फा, फम्). C.-tongued: द्विजिह्वः (ह्वा, ह्वं) (=double-tongued), Śi.
clover: CLOVER: त्रिपर्णी (?). To live in c. i. e. luxurious-ly: q. v.
clown: CLOWN: I A countryman: (1) ग्रामिकः; (2) ग्राम्यजनः; (3) कृषीवलः (=agriculturist). II A buffoon: q. v.: भण्डः।
clownish: CLOWNISH: (1) ग्राम्यः (म्या, म्यं); (2) अशिष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं) (not polite.).
cloy: CLOY (v.): सं-तर्पयति (c. of तृप्): v. To sati--ate.
club: CLUB (subs.): I A cudgel: (1) यष्टिः; (2) लगुडः, to maul severely with c. s. लगुडप्रहारैर्जर्जरी-करोति, P. II An association: q. v.: समाजः (?), who will not come to the c. today: योऽद्य समाजे  नागमिष्यति, V. p.
club together: CLUB TOGETHER (v.): I To eat together: सं-खादति (खाद्, c. 1) (?) II To contribute: q. v.
clue: CLUE: I A ball of thread: सूत्रकोपम् (?). II Anything serving to guide: Ph. to get a c. सन्धानं प्राप्नोति (?); to give a. c. सन्धानं ददाति (?).
clump: CLUMP: (1) गुच्छः; (2) निचयः, संहतिः, etc. in comp., a c. of creepers: विरुन्निचयः, Ve.; c. of plantain trees: कदलीषण्डः, Mah. or कदलीगुल्मः Ra.; (3) वनम् (a large c.), a c. of lotus: कुमु-द्वनम्, Ki.
clumsy: CLUMSY: (1) असुन्दरः (री, रं) (=inelegant); (2) ग्राम्यः (म्या, म्यं) (=rustic); (3) अकृतिन् (f. नी) (=unskilful).
cluster: CLUSTER (subs.): (1) चयः, नि-, c. of ashes: भस्मनां चयः, Ki.; (2) संहतिः, R.; (3) स्तवकः (of fruit or flower), with fresh c. s of flower प्रसूनस्तवकैर्नवीनैः, N.: v. Crowd, assemblage.
CLUSTER (v.): c. ed by wind: अनिलेन विरचित-संहतिः, K.: v. To flock, swarm. “C. ing grapes.” *स्तवकमयानि द्राक्षाफलानि।
clutch: CLUTCH (v.): आदत्ते (दा, c. 3): v. To seize, grasp. To c. the hand: मुष्टिं बध्नाति।
clutches: CLUTCHES (subs.): हस्तः, under the c. of death: मृत्युहस्तवर्तिन् (f. नी), D.
coagulate: COAGULATE: (1) घनीभवति; (2) श्यामीभवति; (3) श्यायते (श्यै, c. l).
coal: COAL: (1) अङ्गार, (=charcoal); (2) अङ्गाराश्मन् (m.) or अङ्गारमृत्तिका। C.-heaver: अङ्गारवाहकः (?). C.-pit: अङ्गारभूमिः (?).
coarse: COARSE: I Not fine: स्थूलः (ला, लं), c. cloth स्थलवस्त्रम्, P.; body is of two kinds, c. and fine: [Page128] द्विविधं शरीरं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं च, S. iv. 3. II Rude, unpolished, mean: q. v.
coarseness: COARSENESS: I Lit.: (1) स्थूलता; (2) स्थौल्यम्। II Rudeness; vulgarity: q. v.
coast: COAST (subs.): तीरम्, whether he reached the c. तीरमगमद्वा, D.: v. Shore. Ph.: c.-line वेला, R. xiii. 15.; “the c. is clear (i. e. danger is over): निष्कण्टका भूमिः (?).
COAST (v. i.): उपकूलं पोतं वाहयति or पोतेन गच्छति (?).
coasting: COASTING (adj.): Ph.: c. vessel (i. e. a coaster) *उपकूलपोतः, c. -trade: *उपकूलवाणिज्यम्।
coat: COAT (subs.): An article of dress: *कोटभ्। II A covering: q. v. (1) आवरणम्, c. s. of mail: देहावरणानि, Ki.: v. Armour; (2) पटलम् (of the eye). Ph.: c. of arms: *चोलचिह्नम्।
coating: COATING (subs.): v. Covering, coat (II). C. (of a paint): लेपः, K.
coax: COAX (v.): v. To wheedle, fondle, soothe.
coaxingly: COAXINGLY: i. e. by c.: (1) प्रियशतमधुराभिर्वाग्भिः K.; (2) चाटूक्तिभिः or चाटुशतैः (by flattery), H.; (3) अभ्यर्थनाभिः (begging), K.
cobble: COBBLE: I To mend: q. v. II To do badly: v. To do, badly.
cobweb: COBWEB: I Lit.: जाल (mn.) or मर्कटकीटसूत्रजालम्, V. d., and sim. comp. s (when the meaning is not clear). II Fig.: जाल (mn.), D.
cock: COCK (subs.): (1) कुक्कुटः; (2) ताम्रचूडः, कृकवाकुः। A. c. sparrow: चटकः: v. Male. “The c. of the club:” समाजपुङ्गवः (?). C. -a-hoop: दृप्तः (प्ता, प्तं).
COCK (v.): I To turn up: q. v.: उन्नमयति (c. of नम्). II To c. a gun: *बन्दुकस्य घोटकम्  उन्नमयति (घोटकः = c. in Bengali). (A) c. ed (hat) साचिनिवेशितः (ता, तं) (?).
cock-fight: COCK-FIGHT, COCK-FIGHTING: (1) कुक्कुटयुद्धम्; (2) ताम्रचूडयुद्धम्, D. v.
cockle: COCKLE: I A plant: ओषधिभेदः। II A shell--fish: दीर्घकोषिका (?).
cockroach: COCKROACH: (1) तैलपा or तैलपायिका; (2) परोष्णी; (3) खलाधारा।
cocoanut: COCOANUT: नारिकेलम्। C. -husk: नारिकेलीफलवल्कलम्, K.; c. tree: नारिकेलः, -ली; c. water: नारिकेलापः or नारिकेलान्तरापः, Si. iii. 81.; नारिकेलीरसः, Vi.; c. wine: नारिकेलासवः, R. iv. 42.
code: CODE: संहिता, c. of Manu: मनुसंहिता; penal c.: *दण्डविधिसंहिता।
codify: CODIFY: p. p. To c. laws: *विधीन् संहितायां  निबध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9.).
coefficient: COEFFICIENT: मानम्, c. of an unknown quantity: अव्यक्तराशेर्मानम्, Vij.
coerce: COERCE (v.): नियन्त्रयति (यन्त्र्, c. 10.): v. To restrain, compel.
coercion: COERCION: नियन्त्रणा, K.: v. Restraint, com--pulsion.
coercive: COERCIVE: नियण्त्रृ (f. न्त्री) (?); expr. by circum.
co-eternal: CO-ETERNAL: expr. by circum: v. Eternal.
coeval: COEVAL: (1) समकालीनः (ना, नं); (2) समानकालीनः (ना, नं), V. d.; (3) तुल्यकालः (ला, लं), V. p.
co-exist: CO-EXIST (v.): समं or एकत्र वर्तते (वृत्, c. l.) or विद्यते (विद्, c. 4.).
co-existence: CO-EXISTENCE: एककालावस्थायित्वम्, V. d.; better by circum.
co-existent: CO-EXISTENT: expr. by circrm., pleasure and pain are not c.: सुखदुःखे न वर्तेते समम्।
coffer: COFFER: धनभाण्डम् (?), his c. s are empty: रिक्तानि  तस्य धनभाण्डानि (?)
coffin: COFFIN: शवाधारः, and sim. com. s (?).
cog: COG (subs.): दन्तः (when the sense is clear) (?); चक्रदन्तः (?).
COG (v.): v. To deceive, cheat. C. ged, i. e. furnished with c. s: दन्तविशिष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं), and sim. comp.
cogent: COGENT: बलवत् (f. ती): v. Forcible, weighty.
cognizance: COGNIZANCE: I Knowledge: q. v. II Juris--diction: q. v. III A badge: q. v. Ph. I cannot take c. of it: *इदमवेक्षितुं भेऽमेधिकारो नास्ति।
cohabit: COHABIT: (1) सहवासं करोति (कृ, c. 8.); (2) सं-वसति (वस्, c. 1.).
cohabitation: COHABITATION: सहवासः or संवासः, M. viii. 373.
coherence: COHERENCE, COHERENCY: I Adherence: q. v. II Connexion, consistency: q. v.
cohere: COHERE (v.): I To adhere, stick together: q. v. II To agree, be consistent: q. v.
coherent: COHERENT: I Cleaving: संसक्तः (क्ता, क्तं). II Consistent, adapted: q. v.
coil: COIL (subs.): (1) गुणः (of a rope); (2) कुण्डलम् (of a serpent); (3) व्यावर्तनम् (c. ing round), by the c. s of the serpent-king: व्यावर्तनैरहिपतेः, Ki.
COIL (v.): (1) पिण्डीकरोति (into a globe); (2) कुण्डलीकरोति, V. p. com. C. ed round by the serpent-king: सर्पराजेन भोगेनावेष्टितः (ता, तं), V. p.
coin: COIN (subs.): (1) मुद्रा, copper -c.: ताम्रमुद्रा; (2) नाणकम् (rare), Mr. To pay any one in his own c. *सदृशशोधं ददाति।
COIN (v.): I To stamp: टङ्कयति (nomi.) (?). II To invent, originate: q. v. सृजति (सृज्, c. 6.).
coinage: COINAGE: I Coining: टङ्कनम् (?). II Money coined: मुद्रा। III Invention: q. v.: सृष्टिः।
coincide: COINCIDE (v.): I To Agree, correspond, concur: q. v. II To agree in position: एकीभवति।
coincidence: COINCIDENCE: I Agreement, correspon--dence: q. v. II Agreement in position expr. by verb. III Accident: दैवयोगः।
coincident: COINCIDENT, COINCIDENTAL: I Of time: समकालीनः (ना, नं). II Consistent: q. v. III Corresponding: q. v.
coiner: COINER: I Lit.: मुद्राकारः (?). II An inven--tor, maker: q. v.
cold: COLD (adj.): I Lit: (1) शीतः (ता, तं), c. weather: शीतकालः, Ri. vi. 7.; (2) शीतलः (ला,  लं) (gen. = cool), c. nights: शीतला रात्रयः, Ri. V. 4.; (3) शिशिरः (रा, रं), c. as ice: तुषार-शिशिरः (रा, रं) K.; (4) हिमः (मा, मं) (rare); (5) तुषारः (रा, रं) (rare); (6) निरुष्णः (ष्णा, ष्णं), अघर्मः (र्मा। र्मं) etc. (poet). C. season: (1) हेमन्त (mn.) (from about the middle of November to about the m. of January); (2) शिशिर (mn.) (from a. the m. of J. to a. the m. of March). Ph. I am c. शीतं मे, P. iii. 7. III Fig.: in--different, reserved: q. v.

COLD (subs.): I Lit.: (1) शीतम्, capacity of enduring c.: शीतसहिष्णुता, Ka.; (2) हिमम्, suffer-ing from c.: हिमार्तः Sa.; save me from c.: हिमत्राणं विधीयतां, P. II Catarrh: (1) प्रति(ती)श्यायः, giving c.: प्रतिश्यायकरः (री, रं), Sr.; (2) पीनसः, suffering from c. पीनसिन् (नी), Sr. Ph.: to catch c.: प्रतिश्यायः सम्-जायते (जन्, c. 4.) or भवति (with gen. of the person).
coldness: COLDNESS: I Lit.: (1) शैत्यम् or शीतता, from great c.: अतिशैत्यात्, M. n.; (2) निरुष्णता, etc. (poet). II Apathy, indifference: q. v.: अनादरः।
collapse: COLLAPSE (subs.): I Lit.: संकोचः। II Fig.: क्षयः: v. Fall, ruin.
COLLAPSE (v.): I To shrink up: q. v.: संकुचति (कुच्, c. 6.). II Fig.: to fail q. v.: क्षयं or नाशं गच्छति, व्रजति, etc.
collar: COLLAR (subs.): (1) ग्रैवेयम् or ग्रैवेयकम्; (2) कण्ठिका; (3) कण्ठभूषणम्। C. (of machines): *परिकरः।
COLLAR (v. t.): (1) ग्रैवेयकेन धरति (धृ, c. l.) or गृह्वाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.): v. To seize.
collate: COLLATE: I To compare critically: (1) परीक्षते (ईक्ष्, c. 1.); (2) समवलोकते (लोक्, c. l.). II To appoint, to confer: q. v.: नियोजयति (युज्, c. 10).
collateral: COLLATERAL: I Indirect: q. v.: प्रासङ्गिकः (की, कं). II Of pedigree: not in the direct line: मिन्नशास्वः (खा, खं) (?); उपलोमः (मा,  मं) (?).
collaterally: COLLATERALLY: Of indirect descent: expr. by circum.
collation: COLLATION. I Comparison: (1) परीक्षा; (2) समवलोकनम्। II Presentation to a benefice: नियोगः or विनियोगः। III Cold repast: कल्यवर्तः।
collect: COLLECT (v. t.): I To gather: (1) सं-गृह्वाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.), to c. dust: पांशून् संगृह्णाति, M.; (2) समाहरति (हृ, c. 1.), c. ing dictionaries: कोषान्  समाहृत्य, Nil.; (3) समर्जयति (अर्ज्, c. 10.) (of earning), c. ing gems: समर्जयन् रत्नानि, K.; (4) सन्निपातयति (c. of पत्) (=to assemble: q. v.); (5) आदत्ते (दा, c. 3.) (=to take) (only of taxes etc.); (6) राशीकरोति, पूगीकरोति or पुञ्जी-करोति (c. into a heap). Ph.: to c. one's self आत्मानं संस्थापयति, पर्यव-, (c. of स्था), Mr. iii. To infer: q. v.
COLLECT (v. i.): (1) समागच्छति (गम्, c. 2.), समैति (इ, c. 2.), etc.: v. To assemble; (2) राशी-भवति, पूगीभवति, पुञ्जीभवति (=to c. into a heap).
collected: COLLECTED (adj.): i. e. not disconcerted, cool: स्थिरः (रा, रं), you should be always c. like this: एवमेव सदा भाव्यं स्थिरेण॥।, Mah.
collection: COLLECTION: I The act: (1) संग्रहः; (2) समाहारः (rare). II Assemblage, crowd: q. v.: सङ्घः। III Money collected. Ph.: pay your c. s *यद्धनं त्वया समाहृतं तद्देहि। IV Con--clusion: q. v.
collective: COLLECTIVE: (1) समवेतः (ता, तं); (2) संहतः (ता,  तं). C. -ness: सङ्घवृत्तिता, Ki.
collectively: COLLECTIVELY: expr. by adj., the birds c.: संहतास्तु विहङ्गमाः, H.: v. Jointly, together.
collector: COLLECTOR: संग्रहीतृ or समाहर्तृ (f. र्त्रीं) (?), tax -c.: *करसमाहर्ता; c. of a district (in India): करनायकः (after दण्डनायकः magistrate); c. of customs: *शुल्कनायकः।
college: COLLEGE: विद्यालयः or प्रधानविद्यालयः, and sim. comp. s; of your c. -life अत्रमवतः विद्यागृहमधिवसतः, K.
collegiate: COLLEGIATE: expr. by com., c. church: *विद्यालयधर्ममन्दिरम्।
collision: COLLISION: सघट्टः (with a defining word when the sense is not clear, as *लोहपथयानसङ्घट्टः to denote railway c.).
collop: COLLOP: फालिका, c. of meat: मांसफालिका, N. xvi. 82.: v. Piece.
colloquial: COLLOQUIAL: Ph.: c. language प्राकृतभाषा (?); c. talent: सम्भाषणशक्तिः (?).
collusion: COLLUSION: (1) निभृतसंयोगः (=secret union); (2) शठ्यम् (=deceit: q. v.).
colonial: COLONIAL: expr. by comp. c. governor: *अधिनिवेशपालः।
colonize: COLONIZE: *अधिनिवेशयति (c. of विश्), should c. places by the excess population of one's country: जनपदं स्वदेशाभिष्यन्दवमनेन निवेशयेत्, M. n.
colossal: COLOSSAL: महाप्रमाणः (णा, णं), K. v.: Huge.
colour: COLOUR (subs.): I A property of bodies: (1) वर्णः, seeing that it changed c. in a golden vessel: कनकभाजने वर्णान्तरमुपगतमुपलभ्य, Mu. ii.; (2) रागः or रङ्गः (rare), c. of the cheek: कपोल-रागः, Ki. II A pigment: (1) रङ्गः, of lasting c. स्थिररङ्गः (ङ्गा, ङ्गं); (2) वर्णः, -कः (rare), from the vividness of the c. वर्णकोच्छ्वासात्, Sa. vi. Ph.: you know how to paint sin in the blackest c. s: *घोरकृष्णरङ्गैः पातकं चित्रयितुं जानासि। III Pretext q. v.: व्यपदेशः। IV In pl. a. flag, ensign: q. v.: ध्वजः।
COLOUR (v. t.): I Lit: (1) रञ्जयति (c. of रञ्ज्); (2) वर्णयति (वर्ण्, c. 10.) (rare in this sense); (3) चित्रयति (चित्र्, c. 10.) (=to paint). II To palliate, pretend: q. v.
COLOUR (v. i.): Ph.: his face c. ed *तस्य  वदनमारक्तं बभूव or रक्तवर्णमापेदे or भेजे।
coloured: COLOURED (adj.): Ph.: red -c. रक्तवर्णः (र्णा, र्णं); many -c. नानावर्णः (र्णा, र्णं) c. people. आफ्रिकादि-देशीयकृष्णवर्णलोकाः।
colouring: COLOURING (subs.): I Lit.: रञ्जनम्। II Fig., of style: वर्णनम्: v. Ornament.
colourist: COLOURIST: चित्रकरः (=painter: q. v.: not रञ्जकः, which = dyer).
colt: COLT: (1) अश्वशावः (of a horse); (2) गर्दभशावः (of an ass).
column: COLUMN: I A pillar: q. v.: स्तम्भः। II Mili--tary: सूचिः or सूचिव्यूहः, should march in file or c.: दण्डव्यूहेन सूच्या वा यायात्, M. III Of a page: *धारा।
comb: COMB (subs.): I For hair: (1) प्रसाधनी; (2) कङ्कतिका। II For carding wool: *मार्जनी (?). III Of a cock: चूडा। IV Honeycomb: q. v. V. A valley: q. v.
COMB (v. t.): सम्मार्जयति (मृज्, c. 10): v. To dress.
combat: COMBAT (subs.): v. Battle, contest. Ph.: single-c. द्वन्द्वयुद्धम्, close c.: नियुद्धम्।
COMBAT (v. i.): v. To contend, struggle.
COMBAT (v. t.): I To fight with: q. v. II To oppose, resist: q. v.
combatant: COMBATANT: I Lit: योद्धृ (f. द्ध्री). II Fig.: विरोधिन् (f. नी).
combination: COMBINATION: (1) संहतिः, to break their c.: तत्सं-संहतिभेदाय, Mu. II.; c. even of little things: अल्पानामपि वस्तूनां संहतिः, H.; (2) समवायः, much more their c.: किमुतसमवायः, K.: v. Union. Ph.: c. of letters: सन्धिः, c. (in algebra) *समवायः।
combine: COMBINE (v.): I Trans.: v. To join, unite. II Intrans.: expr. by the parts: संहतः (ता, तं), समवेतः (ता, तं), or मिलितः (ता, तं), they c. d together to invade it: इतमभियोक्तुं मिलिता  बभुबुः।
combustible: COMBUSTIBLE: (1) दाह्यः (ह्या, ह्यं); (2) दहनीयः (या, यं). Any c. material: (1) दाह्यम् or दाह्य-पदार्थः; (2) इन्धनम्, R. xiii. 4.
come: COME: (1) आगच्छति (गम्, c. l), I am c. ing: अयमागतोऽस्मि, Mr. ix.; does not c. (back) yet: नाद्याप्यगच्छति, Mr. v.; will he c. here: किमय-मत्रागमिष्यति, K.; (2) एति (इ, c. 2), c. c. my child: एह्येहि वत्स, Vi. i.; (3) आयाति (या, c. 2), came to Yudhishthira: युधिष्ठिरं समाययौ, Ki. [Page132] i. 1. Ph.: the summer season is c.: निदाधकालोऽ-यमुपागतः, Ri. i. l.; the news of his father's death is c.: तस्य पितृमरणवार्ता समागता। N. B. These verbs take an acc.
come about: COME ABOUT: v. Pass, come to.
come after: COME AFTER: I To go after, follow: q. v.: अनुगच्छति (गम्, c. l). II To come for: Ph.: he came after a book: *स पुस्तकार्थमाजगाम।
come again: COME AGAIN: प्रत्यागच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To come back, return.
come along: COME ALONG: (1) आगच्छति; (2) एति: v. To come.
come at: COME AT: अधिगच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To reach, attain.
come away: COME AWAY: I To depart: q. v. II To come off: q. v.
come back: COME BACK: (1) प्रत्यागच्छति; (2) प्रत्यायाति (या, c. 2); (3) प्रत्यावर्तते (वृत्, c. 2).
come by: COME BY: i. e. to gain, obtain, acquire: q. v.
come down: COME DOWN: I To get down, descend: q. v. अवतरति (तॄ, c. l). II To be handed down: Ph. the writings of Kālidāsa have c. to us: कालिदासकृतप्रबन्धा अस्मत्सकाशमागताः।
come forth: COME FORTH: निर्गच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To come out.
come in: COME IN: I To enter: q. v.: प्रविशति (विश्, c. 6): II To comply: q. v. III To become fashionable: v. Fashionable.
come in for: COME IN FOR: Ph.: they did not c. in for a share: *अंशग्रहणाय नाजग्मुः।
come into: COME INTO: v. To agree, comply. Ph.: c. into vogue: प्रचलितः (ता, तं) भवति (भू, c. l); then they will c. into my power: वशमेष्यन्ति मे  तदा, H. i.
come near: COME NEAR: I Lit.: उपसर्पति (सृप्, c. l): v. To approach. II Fig.: Ph.: nothing anci-ent or modern c. s near this achievement *एतादृशं  कर्म कदापि न सम्पन्नम्।
come of: COME OF: i. e. to issue or produce from: q. v.
come off: COME OFF: I To come out of: निष्पतति (पत्, c. l), fire came off his eye: अक्ष्णः कृशानुः किल  निष्पपात, Ku.: II To be carried through: निर्गच्छति। III To take place: q. v.: आपतति।
come out: COME OUT: I Lit.: निर्गच्छति; (2) निष्क्रामति: v. To go out. II Of the teeth etc.: (1) उद्गच्छति, निर्-, (गम्, c. l); (2) उदेति (इ, c. 2); (3) उद्भिनत्ति (भिद्, c. 7), as no beard had c. out अनुभ्दिन्नश्मश्रुराजितया, K. iii. To be published: निर्गच्छति or बहिर्गच्छति: v. To publish.
come out to meet or receive: COME OUT TO MEET or RECEIVE: (1) प्रत्युद्गच्छति (गम्, c. l), R. viii. 64.; (2) प्रत्युदेति (इ, c. 2); (2) प्रत्युद्याति (या, c. 2).
come over: COME OVER: I To pass over: Ph.: if they get an assailant like you, they will leave him and c. over to you: त्वदृशमभियोक्तारमासाद्यै नं परित्यज्य त्वामे-वाश्रयन्ते, Mu. iv. II Of feelings, etc. Ph.: a sudden chill came over him *सहसा तस्य गात्रं  शीतं बभूव।
come round: COME ROUND: Ph.: he will c. round to our opinion: स स्वमतं परित्यज्यास्माकं मतं ग्रहीष्यति or मतावलम्बनं करिष्यति।
come short: COME SHORT: न्यूनीभवति (भू, c. l): v. To Fall short.
come to: COME TO: I Lit.: v. To come. N. B. With respect to persons सकाशं should be used: I have c. to you here: त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः, M. p. Ph.: c. to memory स्मृतिभागच्छति, A. r.; c. to one's ears: श्रुतिपथमायाति, Sa., श्रुतिमागच्छति, N.; c. to pieces: खण्डखण्डं भवति, let it never c. to pass: मास्मभूत्, Ki.; c. to one's self: संज्ञां लभते (लभ्, c. l) v. To recover; c. to life: उज्जीवति (जीव्, l); c. to an end: अवसानं गच्छतिः v. To end; c. to an agreement: v. To agree. II To arrive at: q. v. III: To amount to: q. v.
come up: COME UP: I Lit.: आपतति, प्रा-, सन्नि-, (पत्, c. l), saw Keyuraka c. -ing up: आपतन्तं केयूरकमद्राक्षीत्, K. II To spring, come out: q. v.: निर्गच्छति।
come up to: COME UP TO: I To arrive at: (1) समुपगच्छति; (2) समागच्छति; (3) समायाति: (4) समुपसर्पति (सृप्, c. l). II Fig.: to equal: q. v.
come up with: COME UP WITH: v. To overtake.
come upon: COME UPON: आक्रामति (क्रम्, c. l): v. To attach.
comedian: COMEDIAN: I An actor: q. v.: नटः। II A writer: *हर्षप्रधाननाटकलेखकः, or रचयितृ (m.) or -कृत,
comely: COMELY: I Becoming: q. v. II Beautiful, handsome: q. v.: सुदर्शनः (ना, नं).
comet: COMET: (1) धूमकेतुः, Ku. iii. 32.; (2) केतुः, Vi.
cometary: COMETARY: (1) by comp. with धमकेतु-; (2) by gen. of धूमकेतु।
comfort: COMFORT (v. t.): आश्वासयति (c. of श्वस्): v. Console, cheer.
COMFORT (subs.): I Consolation, solace: q. v.: आश्वासः। II Pleasure: सुखम्, enjoying every c. सर्वसुखान्यनुमवन्तः, K.
comfortable: COMFORTABLE: are you c. here: अप्यत्र भवत्याः  सुखम्? V. p.: v. Pleasant.
comfortably: COMFORTABLY: सुख-, in comp., sleeping c.: सुखसुप्तः (प्ता, प्तं), Mah.: v. Pleasantly, conveniently.
comforter: COMFORTER: आश्वासकः or expr. by verb: v. To console.
comic: COMIC, COMICAL: I Diverting, sportive: q. v.: (1) हासकरः (री, रं); (2) हासजननः (नी,  नं). II Relating to a comedy: is this drama c. *अपि नाटकमिदं हर्षप्रधानम्।
coming: COMING: I Subs: आगमः, -नं। II Adj.: आगा-मिन् (f. नी).
command: COMMAND (v. t.): I To give a c.: (1) आज्ञा-पयति, सं-, (c. of ज्ञा) (with two acc.), c. (me) what you have to be done: आज्ञापय यत्ते करणीय-मस्ति, Ku. iii. 3; (2) आ-दिशति, नि-, (दिश्, c. 6): v. To order. II To be in c. of: (1) अधितिष्ठति (स्था, c. l), the forces c. ed by my father: ताताधिष्ठितानां बलानाम्, Ve. iii.; (2) अध्यास्ते (आस्, c. 2), Virūpākṣa wanted to c. the heart of the city: विरूपाक्षः पुरोदरमव्यासिसिषांचक्रे, B. xiv. 16. III To govern, control: q. v. IV Of position; expr. by circum, the house c. s a beautiful view of the lake: *अस्माद्गृहात्सरः  सुन्दरमवलोकयिन्तुं शक्यते।

COMMAND (subs.): I Order: (1) आज्ञा, at Rāma's c. रामाज्ञया, R.; (2) आदेश: or निदेशः, receiving their master's c.: भर्तुरादेशं समवाप्य, Ki. vi. 43,; (3) शासनम् (a stronger term), who would transgress your majesty's c.: कोदेवस्य शासन-मुल्लङ्घयिष्यति, Mu. iii.; (4) नियोगः (=direc--tion), by his father's c.: पितुर्नियोगात्, R. xiv. 43. II The power to c.: expr. by circum., putting himself in c. of his treasury and army: तत्कोषवाहनमात्माधिष्ठितं कृत्वा, D. viii.: v. To command (II); appoint (him) to the c. of the army: अभिषिच्यतां सैनापत्ये, Ve. III Control, government: q. v.
commander: COMMANDER: I Lit.: (1) आज्ञापकः, c. of all kings: सर्वभूतलभुजामाज्ञापकः, Mu. ii.; (2) आदेष्ट्ट (m.). II Of an army: (1) सेनानीः; (2) सेनापतिः; (3) सेनाध्यक्षः III Of a vessel: पोताध्यक्षः; पोतनायकः; and im. comp. s. Ph.: c. -in-chief: महासनापतिः (used in ancient grants): v. Generalissimo.
commemorate: COMMEMORATE: कीर्तयति, सं-, (कीर्त्, c. 10) (?): v. To celebrate.
commence: COMMENCE: (1) आरभते (रभ्, c. l); (2) प्रक्रमते (क्रम्, c. l): v. To begin.
commend: COMMEND (v. t.): I To entrust, deliver: q. v.: अर्पयति (c. of ॠ). II To praise: q. v.: प्रशंसति (शंस्, c. l). III To recommend: q. v. IV To present as worthy of regard: expr. by अभि-मतः (ता, तं) or circum., what you say does not c. to me: त्वद्वचो नामिनन्दामि, Sa.
commendation: COMMENDATION: I Approbation, praise: q. v. II Recommendation: q. v. III Com--pliments: q. v.
commendatory: COMMENDATORY: I Subs.: v. Praise. II Adj.: expr. by comp. Ph.: this is c.: अर्थवाद एषः, U.
commensurate: COMMENSURATE: I Lit.: सजातीयः (या, यं) (?). II Proportional: q. v.
comment: COMMENT (v.): I To annotate: q. v. II To make remarks: अनुयुनक्ति (युज्, c. l) (?): v. Remark.
COMMENT (subs.): I In pl., observations, remarks: q. v. II Annotation, explana--tion: q. v.
commentary: COMMENTARY: I Lit.: (1) व्याख्या; (2) वृत्तिः, c. on Manu: मनुवृत्तिः, K. b.; (3) टीका, Rāmā-yaṇa with its c.: सटीकं रामायणम्; (4) भाष्यम् (=c. on aphorisms). II Criticism: q. v. Ph.: c. s. of Caesar.: *किंशूरव्याख्यानम्।
commentator: COMMENTATOR: (1) व्याख्यातृ (m.); (2) टीकाकारः; (3) भाष्यकारः (c. of aphorisms).
commerce: COMMERCE: I Trade, traffic: वाणिज्यम्। II Intercourse: q. v.
commercial: COMMERCIAL: (1) comp. with वाणिज्य-; (2) वाणिज्यविषयकः (का, कं). C.-treaty *वाणिज्य-द्रव्याणामागमनिर्गमविषयकः सन्धिः; a c. nation *वाणिज्यपरायणा जातिः।
commingle: COMMINGLE: मिश्रयति, सं-, (मिश्र्, c. 10.): v. To mingle.
comminute: COMMINUTE: चूर्णयति (चूर्ण्, c. 10.): v. To pulverize, grind.
commiserate: COMMISERATE: दयते (दय्, c. l.): v. To pity.
commissariat: COMMISSARIAT: I The department: *वीवध-दानविभागः II Commissaryship: अधिकारः (?)
commission: COMMISSION (subs.): I Perpetration: q. v.: Ph.: c. of sin: पापाचरणम्, K. b.; was caught in the c. of theft: चौर्यं कुर्वन् गृहीतः। II Entrusting: अर्पणम्, सम्-। III The business entrusted: नियोगः, attend to your c.: स्वं नियोगमशून्यं कुरु, Sa. IV A number of persons joined in an office or trust: *परीक्षकाः (m. pl.). V. Allow--ance for transacting business: no equiv.: expr. by circum. VI In the army: पदम् (?).
COMMISSION (v.): नियुंक्ते (युज्, c. 7.): v. To charge, empower.
commissioner: COMMISSIONER: I In gen. sense: अधिकृतः, a careless c.: अधिकृतः प्रमादी, H. II Of a divi sion: प्रदेशपालः।
commit: COMMIT (v. t.): I To entrust: q. v.: अर्पयति, सम्-, (c. of ॠ), c. these (prisoners) to his care: तस्मै समर्पयैतान्, P. Ph.: was c. ted to prison: बन्धनमनीयत, D. ii.; to c. to the sessions: *अधिवेशनविचारार्थम् अर्पयति; to c. to memory: कण्ठस्थं करोति; c. (this) to writing : अभिलिख्यताम्, Mr. ix. II To perpetrate : करोति (कृ, c. 8.), to c. crimes wilfully: कामतः पापानि करोति M.; one who c. s an offence : अपराधिन् (f. नी). III To match: q. v.
commitment: COMMITMENT: To the sessions: *अधिवेशन- विचारार्पणम्। For other senses: v. To commit.
commodiousness: COMMODIOUSNESS: I Convenience: q. v. II. Spaciousness: q. v.
commodity: COMMODITY: पण्यम्, import and export of c. s पण्यानामागमनिर्गमौ, M.
common: COMMON (adj.): I Belonging to more than one: (1) साधारणः (णी णं), c. property साधारणधनम्, Da.; c. to many: बहुसाधारण (णी, णं), Da.; (2) सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं), thi (gem) is c. to me and Balabhadra: एतन्म।  बलभद्रस्य च सामान्यम्, V. p. II Usual, ordinary (1) साधारणः (णी णं), c. council: साधारणसभा c. crier: *साधारणघोषकः; c. noun: *साधारणनाम (n.); (2) सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं), “c. dame” सामान्यनायिका, Sah.; c. weaver: साभान्यकौलिक P. ii. 5.; c. word: सामान्यशब्दः, N. d,; a c. man: सामान्यजनः, Ra. v. (इतरः, V. p.). Ph. c. saying: जनप्रवादः, N.; c. gender: स्त्रीपुंलिङ्गम् c. law: देशाचारः; the c. people: लौकिकाः, T. or प्रकृतयः, R.; c. sense: विवेकः।
COMMON; IN: (1) सामान्येन or सामान्यतः, but the three gems were held in c.: किन्तु रत्नत्रयं साभान्ये  स्थितभ्, Vet.; (2) साधारण्येन, in c. with others *अन्येषां साधारण्येन।
commonplace: COMMONPLACE: I Adj.: सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं). C. book: *सामान्यसन्निवेशः। II Subs.: साधारणप्रवादः।
commons: COMMONS: I The mass of the people: (1) प्रजाः (f. pl.); (2) प्रकृतयः (f. pl.); (3) लोकाः (m. pl.). The House of C.: *प्रजासभा। A member of the H. of C.: *प्रजासभासदस्यः or प्रजासभास्थः। II Provisions, food: q. v.
commune: COMMUNE (v. i.): सम्भाषते (भाष c. l.): v. To converse.
communicable: COMMUNICABLE: (1) देयः, प्र-, (या, यं), (what can be given); (2) कथनीयः (या, यं) (what can be spoken).
communicate: COMMUNICATE (v. t.): I To impart, bestow: q. v.: (1) ददाति (दा, c. 4.), to c. knowledge: विद्यां दातुम्, Ki.; (2) वितरति (तॄ, c. l.), c. d. meditation योगं विततार, Ki. II To reveal: q. v.: (1) कथयति (कथ, c. 10.), c. (to us) the cause of your distemper: कथय किंनिमित्तस्तेऽयं  सन्तापः, Sa. iii.: v. To speak; (2) आख्याति (ख्या, c. 2.), what cannot be c. d: अनाख्येयः (या, यं), K.: v. To represent. III To share: q. v.
COMMUNICATE (v. i.);: I To share: q. v. II To converse: q. v.
communication: COMMUNICATION: I The act of imparting: (1) दानम्; (2) वितरणम्। II Conversation: q. v. III Intercourse: q. v. IV News: q. v.: सन्देशः: v. Passage: q. v.
communion: COMMUNION: I Intercourse: q. v.: संसर्गः। II The Lord's supper: *प्रभोर्भोजनम्। III A. body of Christians: समाजः।
community: COMMUNITY: I Common possession: सामान्यम्। II A society of people: समाजः। III The people in general: प्रजाः (f. pl.).
commutable: COMMUTABLE: expr. by ph.: v. To COMMUTE.
commute: COMMUTE: I To exchange: q. v. II Of punishment: his sentence of death was c. d to banishment: *तस्य प्राणदण्डमुन्मूल्य निर्वासनभादिष्टम्।
compact: COMPACT (adj.): (1) संहतः (तां, तं), सु-; (2) निविडः (डा, डं); (3) सान्द्रः (न्द्रा, न्द्रं): v. Dense.
compactly: COMPACTLY: expr. by adj.: v. Densely.
compactness: COMPACTNESS: I Density, solidity,: q. v.: संधातः II Of style: संक्षेपः।
companion: COMPANION: (1) सहचरः (f. री), in the hand of his c. spring: सहचरमधुहस्ते, Ku.; (2) सखा (f. खी) (=boon c.), in the presence of her two c. s.: सख्योः समक्षम्, Ku.; (3) सहचारिन् (f. णी), they were c. s from childhood and exceedingly fond of each other: तौ बाल्यात् प्रभृति सहचारिणौ,  परस्परमतीव स्नेहपरौ, P.: v. Also partner, attendant.
companionship: COMPANIONSHIP: (1) साहचर्यम्, Ku.; (2) सह-चरत्वम्, M. n..
company: COMPANY: I Companionship: q. v. To bear c.: v. To accompany. To keep c.: v. To associate. II An assemblage or associa--tion: q. v.: (1) समाजः; (2) दलम्। III For trading purposes: *दलम्। IV Of soldiers: (1) गुल्भः; (2) दलम् (?). V. A ship's crew: q. v.
comparable: COMPARABLE: (1) तुल्यः (ल्या, ल्यं); (2) सदृशः (शी, शं): v. Like.
comparative: COMPARATIVE I Not positive: Ph.: c. levity to water: *जलापेक्षया लाघवम्; the c. advantages of this place: अन्यान्यस्थानापेक्षायास्य स्थानस्य गुणाः। II In gram.: द्वयोरेकस्यातिशयद्योतकः (का, कं). III Based on comprehensive comparison: c. anatomy: *विश्वव्यवच्छेदविद्यासारः।
comparatively: COMPARATIVELY: often not expr., c. taller: द्राधीयस (f. सी), Ki. xi. 2.; c. lovelier: [Page136] पूर्वाकाराधिकतररुच्, R. viii. 95.: v. Compara--tive (I.)
compare: COMPARE (v. t.): I To examine: q. v.: एकत्र-परीक्षते (ईक्ष्, c. l.). II To liken q. v.: (1) तुलयति (तुल्, c. 10.), and it is c. d with the moon: तदपि च शशाङ्केन तुलितम्, J.; (2) उपमिमीते (मा, c. 3.), there is nothing to be c. d with you nor any thing with which you may be c. d: नोपमानमसि नाप्युपमेयः, Ki.
compared with: COMPARED WITH: (1) तुलनया; (2) औपम्येन; (3) better by comp. degree.
comparison: COMPARISON: (1) तुला or तुलना, then there could be c. with her: अस्यास्ततः स्यात्तुलनापि नाम, N.; (2) उपभा, -नं, bore c. with trees: महीरुहाणामुपमानं  दधुः, Si.: v. Likeness. Standard of c.: उपमानम्, your body which was the standard of c. on account of its beauty: उपमानमभूत्करणं यत्तव  कान्तिमत्तया, Ku. Subject of c.: उपमेयः (या, यं) of the standard and the subject of c. उपमानोप-मेययोः, Kav.
compartment: COMPARTMENT: I Of an edifice: (1) कक्षा; (2) शाला; houses with numerous c. s: भूरिशालानि  गृहाणि, Si. II A division: (1) खण्ड (mn.); (2) परिच्छेदः; (3) विमागः।
compass: COMPASS (subs.): I Circuit, extent: q. v.: परिसरः। II An instrument: दिङ्निर्णययन्त्रम्।
COMPASS (v.): I To encompass: q. v. II To attain: q. v.: अधिगच्छति। III To contrive: q. v.
compassion: COMPASSION: (1) अनुकम्पा, c. for animals: भूतानु-कम्पा, R.; (2) अनुक्रोशः (rare): v. Pity.
COMPASSION, TO HAVE or FEEL: अनुकम्पते (कम्प्, c. l.) (with acc.). v.: To pity.
compassionate: COMPASSIONATE (adj.): करुणार्द्रः (र्द्रा, र्द्रं); (2) सदयः (या, यं); (3) कृपालु (mfn.); (4) दयालु (mfn.); (5) सानुकम्पः (म्पा, म्पं); (6) कारुणिकः (की, कं): v. Pitiful.
compel: COMPEL: I To constrain: expr. by casual form with बलात् or बलेन, should be c. led to reside: बलाद् वासयितव्यः, Vri.; to c. to do work: बलादिष्टं कर्म कारयति, Viv. II To seize: बलाद्  गृह्णाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.). C. led: sometime = must: q. v.
compellable: COMPELLABLE: expr. by future pass. part: c. to pay: बलाद्दाप्यः (प्या, प्यं); c. to do: बलात्  कार्यः (र्या, र्यं).
compendious: COMPENDIOUS: संक्षिप्तः (प्ता, प्तं): v. Brief, concise.
compendium: COMPENDIUM: (1) सारः, c. of political science: नोतिसारः; (2) सारसंग्रहः, S. g.
compensate: COMPENSATE (v. t.): I To recompense: उदयं  ददाति (दा, c. 3.), Viv. II To counter--balance, c. for: often expr. by दूरीकरोति (=distance.).
compete: COMPETE: स्पर्धते (स्पर्ध्, c. l.), the accursed Rākṣasa is c. ing with me: मया सह स्पर्धते  राक्षसहतकः, Mu.: v. To emulate, contend.
competence: COMPETENCE, COMPETENCY: (1) सामर्थ्यम्; (2) शक्तिः, according to one's c. शक्त्यपेक्षम्, N.: v. Ability, sufficiency.
competent: COMPETENT: I Fit.: q. v.: योग्यः (ग्या, ग्यं), c. minister: योग्यसचिवः, Ra.; c. to give evi-dence: साक्षित्वयोग्यः (ग्या, ग्यं), K. b. II Able: q. v.: समर्थः (र्था, र्थं). III Belonging to: q. v.
competently: COMPETENTLY: expr. by adj.: v. Sufficiently.
compilation: COMPILATION: I The act: सङ्कलनम्। II A compiled work: सङ्कलितग्रन्थः।
compile: COMPILE (v. t.): Ph.: a Sanskrit dictionary c. d by Tārānāth Bhaṭṭāchārya श्रीतारानाथमट्टाचार्येण  सङ्कलितं (कल् c. l. and 10.) संस्कृताभिधानम्; c. d. from the works of the elders: पूर्वेषां  शास्त्राण्यालोड्योपन्यास्थत् (अस, c. 4.), D. s.
compiler: COMPILER: सङ्कलयितृ (f. त्री) (when the mean--ing is clear); शास्त्रान्तरेभ्यः सङ्कलयितृ (f. त्री).
complacency: COMPLACENCY: I Satisfaction: q. v.: प्रसादः। II Civility: सौजन्यम्।
complacently: COMPLACENTLY: (1) expr. by the adj; (2) प्रसन्नमनसा।
complain: COMPLAIN: did not c. of her husband: भर्तुरवर्णं  नावदत, R.; c. ed all this in piteous language: कथयमास तत्सर्वं खेदात्करुणभाषिणी, V. p.; other-wise I will go and c. in the court: अन्यथा राज-कुलं गत्वा निवेदयिष्यामि, P.: To represent, lament, accuse.
complainant: COMPLAINANT: (1) अभियोक्तृ (f. क्त्री); (2) अर्थिन् (f. नी); (3) वादिन् (f. नी).
complaint: COMPLAINT: I In law: अभियोगः II A dis--case: पीडा। III In gen. sense: (1) दुःखम् (=distress); (2) विलापः (= lamentation). Ph.: I have heard c. s against you: श्रुतो मया  तवापवादः, P.
complaisance: COMPLAISANCE: दाक्षिण्यम्, from c. towards (us) seeking your favour प्रणयिषु दाक्षिण्यवशात्, V.: v. Courtesy.
complaisant: COMPLAISANT: I Of men: (1) दक्षिणः (णा,  णं); (2) दाक्षिण्यपरवशः (शा, शं), L. II Of acts: प्रियः (या, यं), conduct (of gentlemen) is c.: प्रियप्राया वृत्तिः, U.; with hundreds of c. language like these: इत्यादिभिः प्रियशतैः, U.
complaisantly: COMPLAISANTLY: दाक्षिण्येन or दाक्षिण्यातिशयेन: v. Courteously.
complement: COMPLEMENT: I That which completes: पूरकः (का, कं). II An accessory: सहायः, Sah.
complete: COMPLETE: (adj.): (1) पूर्णः (f. र्णा), परि-, सं-, (=full), not c. by one: एकेनापूर्णः (f. र्णा), R. iii. 33.; (2) समाप्तः (प्ता, प्तं) (=finished, concluded), one whose knowledge is c.: समाप्त-विद्यः (द्या, द्यं), R.

COMPLETE (v. t.): I To accomplish, finish: (1) समापयति, परि-, (c. of आप्) (best equi.), to bring Chandrāpida, who had c. d his knowledge of all arts: परिसमाप्तसकलकलाविज्ञानं चन्द्रापीडमानेतुम्, K.; (2) अवसाययति (c. of सो), c. ing the injunc-tion: विधिमवसाय्य, R. v. 76; (3) अशेषयति (nomi.), c. ing what was to be done: कृत्य-मशेषयित्वा, Ku. vii. 29. II To make up: पूरयति, परि-, सं-, (पूर्, c. 10.), he has c. d it now: तदसौ सम्प्रति पर्य पूरयत्, Si. xvi. 36.
completely: COMPLETELY: (1) सम्पूर्णम् (=fully); (2) अशेषतः and sim. comp. s (=without anything left), (their) wishes are c. fulfilled: निरवशेषं फलिता  मनोरथाः, Ma. x.: v. Entirely.
completion: COMPLETION: (1) समापनम् (the act): v. Accom--plishment; (2) समाप्तिः (the state): v. End.
complexion: COMPLEXION: I Colour of the skin: वर्णः, of a dark c.: कृष्णवर्णः (र्णा, र्णं). Ph.: their c. fell: स विवर्णभावं प्रपेदे, R. vi. 63. II Appearance: q. v.: आकारः। III Temperament: q. v.
compliant: COMPLIANT: I Pliant: q. v. II Obliging: (1) अनुरोधिन् (f. नी); (2) अनुविधायिन् (f. नी); (3) अनुवृत्तिकुशलः (ला, लं).
compliment: COMPLIMENT (subs.): Perh: अभिनन्दनवचः, Paraśurāma presents his c. s. to the king of Ceylon and states: परशुरामो लङ्केश्वरमभिनन्ध ब्रवीति, Vi.
COMPLIMENT (v. t.): प्रशंसति (शंस्, c. l.): v. To praise.
comply: COMPLY (v.): (1) अनुविधत्ते (धा, c. 3.): v. To obey; (2) अनुमन्यते (मन्, c. 4): v. To assent; (3) पूरयति (पूर, c. 10.): v. To satisfy.
comport: COMPORT (v.): I To agree: q. v. II To behave: q. v.: व्यवहरति (हृ, c. l.). III To bear: q. v.
compose: COMPOSE (v. t.): I To constitute: q. v. II Of books etc.: (1) रचयति, वि-, (रच्, c. 10.), c. d this aphorism: इदं सूत्रं रचयांचकार, Mis.; c. d by Bāṇabhaṭṭa: बाणभट्टविरचितः (ता, तं), K.; (2) प्रणयति (नी, c. l.), c. d the life of Rāma: रधुपतेः प्रणिनाय वृत्तम्, Ki.; (3) निबध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9.), this tale is c. d by him: तेनेयं कथा निबद्धा, K.; (4) सम्पादयति (c. of पद्), to c. a speech: भारतिं सम्पादयति, Ki.; (5) ग्रथ्नाति (ग्रन्थ्, c. 9.) (poet), Si.; (6) विदधाति (धा, c. 3.) (rare), B. III To settle: q. v. IV To calm, appease: q. v.: स्थिरीकरोति, Śakuntalā should be c. d by you two: भवतीम्यां स्थिरीकर्तव्या शकुन्तला, Sa. iv. V. In printing: *विन्यस्यति (अस, c. 4.).
composed: COMPOSED (adj.): I Calm: स्थिरः (रा, रं), don't cry, be c.: अलं रुदितेन, स्थिरा भव, Sa. iv. II C. of: v. Made of, consisting of.
composer: COMPOSER: I Of books etc.: (1) रचयितृ (f. त्री), वि-; (2) प्रणेतृ (f. त्री); (3) निबन्धृ (f. न्ध्री) (rare). II One who calms: शभयितृ (f. त्री).
composition: COMPOSITION: I Of books etc.: (1) रचना,  वि-; (2) प्रणयनम्। II A book etc. composed: expr. by verb, this poem is Kālidās's c.: काव्यमिदं कालिदासेन प्रणीतम्: v. Work. III Combinatin: q. v. IV Adjustment of an obligation: Perh: निस्तारः।
compost: COMPOST: I Manure: q. v. II A mixture: q. v.
composure: COMPOSURE: धैर्यम्, the son of Pāṇḍu, although enraged, maintained his c.: जहौ न धैर्यं कुपितोऽपि  पाण्डवः, Ki.: v. Tranquillity.
compound: COMPOUND (adj.): यौगिकः (किं, कं), c. word: यौगिकशब्दः। Ph.: c. interest चक्रवृद्धिः, Viv.
COMPOUND (subs.): I A. c. substance: यौगिक-पदार्थः। II A c. word: (1) योगिकशब्दः; (2) समासः, determined the analysis of c. s: समासयो-र्विग्रहं व्यवससुः, Si.
COMPOUND (v. t.): I To make: q. v.: विरचयति (रच्, c. 10.), I will c. auspicious ointment: मङ्गलसमालभनं विरचयामि, Sa. II To combine: q. v. III To settle: संधत्ते (धा, c. 3.) (?).
comprehend: COMPREHEND (v. t.): I To comprise, include: q. v. II To understand, grasp mentally: (1) गृह्वाति, परि-, (ग्रह्, c. 9.), you have well c. ed my meaning: सम्यग्गृहीतवानसि  मदाशयम्, Mu. iii.; (2) वेत्ति (विद्, c. 2.), who c. s your real nature: याथार्थ्यं वेद कस्तव, R.: v. To understand.
comprehensible: COMPREHENSIBLE: (1) ग्राह्यः (ह्या, ह्यं), परि (rare), in easily c. discourse: सुखग्राह्यनिबन्धनेन, Ku. vii. 90.; not c.: दुर्ग्रहः (हा, हं) M. n.; (2) सुबोधः (धा, धं) (=easily c.), M. n.; not c.: दुर्बोधः (धा, धं), Ku. i. 6.: v. Intelligible.
comprehension: COMPREHENSION: I The act of comprehend--ing: (1) बोधः, beyond c.: बोधातीतः (ता, तं); (2) अनुभवः II A summary: q. v. III Understanding: q. v. धीः।
compress: COMPRESS (v. t.): संक्षिपति (क्षिप, c. l.): v. To contact.
comprise: COMPRISE: परिगृह्वाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.): v. To include, contain.
comprised: COMPRISED, BE: अन्तर्भवति (भू, c. l.), is c. in motion: गमनेऽन्तर्भविष्यति, Ta.: v. To include.
compromise: COMPROMISE (v.): I To compound: *आपोषयति (पुष्, c. 10.). II To involve: संक्रामयति (c. of क्रम्), will c. me in this misdeed: इदमकार्यं मयि संक्रामयेत्, Mr. III To endanger: q. v.
compulsion: COMPULSION: बलम् (=force), everything done under c.: सर्वान् बलकृतानर्थान्, N. To use c.: सम्पीडयति (पीड्, c. 10.), Viv.: v. To compel.
compulsory: COMPULSORY: I Compelling: expr. by बल or बलात्कारः, c. gift: बलाद्दत्तम्, M. II Obli--gatory: expr. by अवश्यम्।
computable: COMPUTABLE: (1) गण्यः or गणनीयः (या, यं), not c.: अगण्य: (f. ण्या); (2) संख्येयः (या, यं).
compute: COMPUTE (v.): गणयति (गण्, c. 10.): v. Count, reckon.
concatenate: CONCATENATE: अनुबध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9.): v. To connect.
conceal: CONCEAL (v. t.): (1) गूहति, -ते (गूह्, c. l.), to c. your good fortune: आत्मनो सौमाग्यं निगूहितुम्, V. ii.; I climbed up a tamarind tree and lay c. ed: चिञ्चावृक्षमारुह्य गूढतनुरतिष्ठम्, D. iv.; (2) गोपयति (गुप्, c. 10.), if it is not a subject to be c. ed: न चेद्गोप्यमस्ति, D. iv.; (3) प्रच्छादयति (c. of छद्), and those who c. it (stolen property): ये च प्रच्छादयन्ति तान्, Kat.: v. To cover; (4) निह्वुते (ह्नु, c. 2.) (=to keep back the truth), desirous of c. ing from the mistress: देव्या निह्नोतु-मिच्छुः, Mu.; (5) लीयते (ली, c. 4.) (=to lie c. ed), have now c. ed yourself in the mire: पङ्केऽधुना  लीयसे, Ve.
concealer: CONCEALER: (1) गूहकः, नि-; (2) गोप्तृ, सं-, (m.), buyer, receiver, and c. of stolen property: चोरित-द्रव्याणां क्रोता ग्रहीता संगोप्ता च, Viv.
concealment: CONCEALMENT: (1) गोपनम्, सं-; (2) गूहनम्, नि-; (3) प्रच्छादनम्; (4) निह्नवः, अपह्नु तिः (of facts). In c.: गुप्तम्: v. Privately.
concede: CONCEDE: I To allow: q. v.: अनुमन्यते (मन्, c. 4.). II To suffer to pass: क्षमते (क्षम्, c. l.): v. To admit.
conceit: CONCEIT: I Conception: q. v. II Freak, fancy: q. v. III Self -c.: अभिमानम्: v. Vanity. IV Opinion: q. v.: Ph.: to put any one out of c. with: विरञ्जयति (रञ्ज्, c. 10.).
conceited: CONCEITED: अभिमानिन् (f. नी): v. Vain, proud.
conceivable: CONCEIVABLE: भाव्यः (व्या, व्यं) or भावनीयः (या,  यं), वि-fortitude whose power is not c.: धैर्यमबि-भाव्यवैभवम्, Ki.: v. Comprehensible.
conceive: CONCEIVE (v.): I To c. a child: गर्भं दधाति or धत्ते (धा, c. 3.) or धारयति or धरति (धृ, c. 10. and 1.), to c. by him: तस्माद्गर्भं दधाति (after R.). Ph.: and the Queen of Benares c. d a daughter: काशिराजस्य पत्न्याश्च गर्भे कन्या आसीत्, V. p.: v. Pregnant. II To form in the mind: भावयति, वि-, (c. of भू), c. ing the frailty of every substance: भावयित्वानित्यतां सर्वभावानां, K.: v. Think, desire. III To imagine: q. v.: सम्भावयति (c. of भू), who would c. that king Chandragupta would sell ornaments: मौर्ये  भूषणाविक्रयं नरपतौ को नाम सम्भावयेत्, Mu.
concentrate: CONCENTRATE: I To bring together: समा-हरति (हृ, c. l.). II Of the mind expr. by adj.: एकाग्रचित्तः (त्ता, त्तं), अनन्यमनस्कः (स्का, स्कं), etc.
concentration: CONCENTRATION: I Bringing together: समाहारः II Of the mind: (1) एकाग्रता; (2) अनन्यमनस्कता।
conception: CONCEPTION: I The act of conceiving (off--spring): (1) गर्भाधानम्; (2) गर्भधारणम्। II For--mation in the mind: भावना, वि-।: v. Imagination. III The faculty of c.: धीः। v. Understanding. IV Notion, idea: q. v.
concern: CONCERN (subs.): I Affairs, business: q. v.: व्यापारः II Care, anxiety: q. v.: चिन्ता। Ph.: with much c.: सोद्वेगम्, Mu. III A firm: सम्प्रदायः (?)

CONCERN (v.): I To affect the interest of: Ph.: this c. s you: भवतस्तावदयं व्यापारः, H. II To make interested in: expr. by verbs: चिन्तयति: (चिन्त्, c. 10.) (=to think) or अवेक्षते (ईक्ष्, c. 10.) (=to look after). III To make uneasy: expr. by adj. s: उद्विग्नः (ग्ना, ग्नं), उत्सुकः (का, कं) or व्यग्रः (ग्रा, ग्रं).
concert: CONCERT (v.): मन्त्रयति (मन्त्र, c. 10.), well c. ed measures succeed: सिव्यन्ति कार्याणि सुमन्त्रितानि, B.: v. To devise, plan.
CONCERT (subs.): I Agreement: q. v.: ऐक्यम्। II Harmony: q. v. III A musical entertainment: सङ्गीतम्।
concession: CONCESSION: I The act of conceding: (1) अनुमोदनम्; (2) अनुमतिः। II A boon: q. v.
conch: CONCH: I A shell: शङ्तः। II A Bahamite: *शङ्घः; बाहमवासिन् (f. नी).
conciliate: CONCILIATE (v.): (1) अनुरञ्जयति (रञ्ज्, c. 10.); (2) प्रसादयति (c. of सद्).
concise: CONCISE: I As applied to language: (1) संक्षिप्तः (प्ता, प्तं), Si. ii. 24.; (2) लघुः (f. घ्वी) (=terse), Si. ii. 23. II As applied to writers etc. expr. by the above: he is a very c. writer: तस्य भाषातिसंक्षिप्ता।
concisely: CONCISELY: (1) संक्षेपतः: v. Briefly; (2) सलाघवम् v. Tersely.
conclave: CONCLAVE: I A private assembly: गूढसभा। II Of cardinals: *रोमकधर्मनियन्तॄणां सभा।
conclude: CONCLUDE (v.): I To shut up: q. v. II To include: q. v. III To infer, guess q. v.: भावयति (c. of भू). IV To finish: q. v.: समापयति (c. of आप्). Ph.: when he c. d: वचस्य-वसिते तस्मिन्, Ku. ii. 53; to c. a treaty: सन्धिं  करोति or विदधाति (धा, c. 3.), H. V. To decide: q. v.: अवधारयति (धृ, c. 10.), K.
conclusion: CONCLUSION: I End: q. v.: (1) समाप्तिः, c. of a song: गीतसमाप्तिः, K.; (2) अवसानम्, at the c. of Sunandā's speech: सुनन्दावचनावसाने, R. II Decision, determination: q. v.: (1) अवधारणा; (2) निर्णयः, come to a c.: निर्णयम् आसीदति, N. III Inference: q. v.: अनुभवः, K. IV Logical c.: (1) निगमनम्, N. d.; (2) निर्णयः, N. d.
concoct: CONCOCT (v.): I To digest: q. v. II To ripen: q. v. III To devise, contrive, plot: q. v.
concoction: CONCOCTION: I Digestion: q. v. II Contri--vance: q. v.
concomitance: CONCOMITANCE: सङ्गः (with gen.); often expr. by sim. सह (=with).
concord: CONCORD: I Union: q. v.: ऐक्यम्। II Com--pact: q. v. III In gram: (1) अन्वयः, सम्-; (2) योजना, remote c.: व्यवहितयोजना, Da. IV Harmony: q. v.: ऐक्यम्।
concordance: CONCORDANCE: I Agreement: q. v. II A glossary: निर्घण्टः।
concourse: CONCOURSE: I A crowd: q. v.: जनसमूहः। II A collection: समवायः।
concrement: CONCREMENT: (1) संहतिः; (2) सङ्घातः, hard by c.: सङ्घातकठिनः (ना, नं), Ku.
concrete: CONCRETE (adj.): I United in growth: (1) संहतः (ता, तं); (2) सङ्घातवत् (f. ती). II Not abstract: Perh. स्थूलः (ला, लं).
concur: CONCUR: I To agree: q. v.: अभ्युपगच्छति (गम्, c. l.). II To assent: अनुमन्यते (मन्, c. 4.).
concurrence: CONCURRENCE: I Union: q. v. II Agree--ment, consent: q. v.: सम्मतिः Ph.: with-out the c. of (my) mother: अननुमोदिता मात्रा, K.
concurrent: CONCURRENT: I Concomitant: q. v. II Equal: q. v.: समानः (ना, नं).
concurrently: CONCURRENTLY: (1) सममेव, Ku. iv. 22.; (2) सहैव, Ki. xiv. 56.
condemn: CONDEMN (v. t.): I To censure: q. v.: निन्दति [Page141] (निन्द्, c. l.) II To pass sentence: दण्डयति (दण्ड्, c. 10.) or दण्डं करोति or दण्डम् आज्ञापयति (c. of ज्ञा) Mu. Ph.: c. to death: वधम् आदिशति (दिश्, c. 6.), P.
condemnable: CONDEMNABLE: (1) दण्डार्हः (र्हा, र्हं) (=deserv--ing of punishment); (2) निन्द्यः (न्द्या, न्द्यं) (=censurable).
condemnation: CONDEMNATION: I Censure: q. v.: उपालम्भः। II Judicial c.: अपराधनिर्णयः, and sim. comp. s; (2) दण्डप्रणयनम् (=passing sentence).
condemner: CONDEMNER: अपराधवादिन् (f. नी) (?): v. Censurer. punisher.
condensation: CONDENSATION: I The act: संहननम् (?). II The state: संहतिः। III Of stile: Perh: समाहारः।
condense: CONDENSE: I Trans.: संहन्ति (हन्, c. 2). II Intrans.: संहतः (ता, तं) भवति (भू, c. l.).
condescend: CONDESCEND: प्रसीदति (सद्, c. l.) (=be pleased), c. to amuse yourself in the southern regions: प्रसीद रन्तुं मलयस्थलीषु, R. vi. 64.: v. To yield, vouchsafe.
condign: CONDIGN: यथार्हः (र्हा, र्हं): v. Suitable; to deserve.
condition: CONDITION: I State, predicament: (1) दशा, very bad c. of the tanks: दीर्घिकाणां सुदुर्दशा, Ku.; that (body) is reduced to this c.: तदिदं गतमीदृशीं  दशाम्, Ku. iv. 5.; (2) अवस्था, in all c. s: सर्वा-वस्थासु, Me. ii. 47. II Stipulation: (1) समयः; (2) अभिसन्धिः। I will give it back on one c.; एकेनाभिसन्धिना प्रत्यर्पयामि, Sa. III Quality, property: q. v.
conditional: CONDITIONAL: I Lit: (1) समययुक्तः (क्ता, क्तं); (2) साभिसन्धि (mfn.). II In gram.: विकल्प-सूचकः (का, कं).
condole: CONDOLE (v.): (1) शोचति (शुच्, c. l.): v. To grieve.
condone: CONDONE: क्षमते (क्षम्, c. l.): v. To forgive.
conduce to: CONDUCE TO or TOWARD: (1) वर्धयति (c. of वृध्) (=to increase) (2) आबहति (वह्, c. l.) (=to bring about); (3) जनयति (c. of जन्) (=to produce).
conducive: CONDUCIVE: (1) आवहः (हा, हं) in comp., c. to sorrow: शोकावहः (हा, हं); (2) करः (री, रं) in comp. (=producing), c. to good: हितकर (री, रं).
conduct: CONDUCT (subs.): I The act of leading: expr. by verb. II Management, guidance: q. v. III Skilful guidance: कौशलम्। IV One who c. s.: expr. by verb. V. Behavi--our: (1) व्यवहारः; (2) वृत्तिः or वृत्तम्, by your c.: तव वृत्तेन, R.: (3) चेष्टा or चेष्टितम्, his brother's c.: भ्रातृचेष्टितम्, P.

CONDUCT (v. t.): I To lead: (1) नयति (नी, c. l.), c. (me) to my residence in a new cloud: नय मां नवेन वसतिं पयोमुचा, V. ; (2) प्रापयति (c. of आप्), to conduct mistresses to the residence of their lovers: कामिनां वसतिं प्रियाः प्रापयितुम्, Ku. iv. II.; (3) अनुगच्छति (गम्, c. l.) to accom--pany Mr. II To direct, control: q. v. III To manage: q. v.: निर्वाहयति (c. of वह्). IV To behave: q. v.: (1) आचरति (चर्, c. l.); (2) व्यवहरति (हृ, c. l.).
conductor: CONDUCTOR: I A leader, guide: q. v.: नायकः II Of heat, etc.: *प्रवाहकः।
cone: CONE: I A solid: शङ्कुः (?); सूचिघनक्षेत्रम्, K. d. II A cone-shaped fruit: *शङ्कुः।
confabulate: CONFABULATE: संकथयति (कथ्, c. 10.): v. To converse.
confederacy: CONFEDERACY: I A league: सन्धिः। II The states bound by a league: सन्धिबद्धराष्ट्राणि (n. pl.) (?).
confederate: CONFEDERATE: I Adj.: सन्धिबद्धः (द्धा, द्धं); संहतः (ता, तं) (=combined). II Subs.; मित्रम् (=ally).
confer: CONFER (v. t.): (1) संवदति (वद्, c. l.): v. To converse; (2) मन्त्रयति (मन्त्र्, c. l.): v. To consult.
CONFER (v. t.); वितरति (तॄ, c. l.), to c. know-ledge: विद्यां वितरति, U.: v. To give. C. a favour: अनुगृह्वाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.): v. To favour.
confess: CONFESS: I To acknowledge: q. v.: (1) स्वीकरोति; (2) प्रतिपद्यते (पद्, c. 4.), and he himself c. ed it: स्वयं च प्रतिपन्नः, Mr. x. II To disclose, reveal: q. v.: प्रकाशयति (c. of काश्).
confessor: CONFESSOR: I A priest who hears confes--sions: *स्वीकारश्रोतृ (m.). II One who con--fesses: (1) स्वीकर्तृ (m.); (2) अभ्युपगन्तृ (m.).
confidant: CONFIDANT: विश्वासभूमिः, विश्रम्भभूमिः, and sim. comp. s: c. in one's all private affairs: सर्व-विश्रम्भभूमिः, K.
confide: CONFIDE (v. i.): विश्वसिति (श्वस्, c. 2.): v. Rely.
CONFIDE (v. t.): न्यस्यति (अस्, c. 4.): v. To entrust.
confidence: CONFIDENCE: I Reliance: (1) विश्वासः to give the birds c.: विश्वासाय विहङ्गानाम्, R. i. 51.; raising c.: विश्वासप्रदः (दा, दं), B. vi. 89.; (2) विश्रम्भः, an object of c. विश्रम्भस्थानम्, K. Ph.: had so much c. in her: तथा तस्यां विशश्वसुः, Ku. V. 15.: विश्रम्भं जग्मुः, M. n.; to inspire with c.: विश्वासयति (c. of श्वस्). H.; to do evil to one who has put c.: विश्रब्धे पापमाचरति, H.; order me with c. what is to be done: विश्रब्ध-मादिश्यतां कर्तव्यम्, K. II Self-c.: प्रागल्भ्यम् or प्रगल्भता, Ki. xvi. 27.
confident: CONFIDENT: I Having confidence: विश्वासिन् (f. नी). II Bold, impudent: q. v.: प्रगल्भः (ल्भा, ल्भं). To be c. of: निश्चितः (ता, तं) मन्यते, is c. of victory: जयं निश्चितं मन्यते: v. Certain.
confidential: CONFIDENTIAL: I Enjoying confidence: (1) विश्वस्त (f. स्ता); (2) विश्रब्ध (f. ब्धा); (3) आप्त (f. प्ता), with some c. princes: कतिपयाप्तराजपुत्र-परिवृतः, K. II Private, secret: Ph.: c. talk: विश्रम्भालापः, H.; in all c. matters: सर्वविश्रम्भेषु, K.
confidentially: CONFIDENTIALLY: (1) विश्वस्तम्; (2) विश्रब्धम्, K.: v. Privately.
confidently: CONFIDENTLY: I Boldly, firmly: q. v.: प्रगल्भम्। II Confidentially: q. v.
confiding: CONFIDING (adj.): (1) विश्वासभाज् (mfn.); (2) विश्वासभुज् (mfn.), N.; and sim. comp. s.
confine: CONFINE (subs.): सीमा: v. Boundary. On the c s of: पर्यन्तस्थः (स्था, स्थं).

CONFINE (v. t.): (1) रुणद्धि, अव-, नि-, (रुध्, c. 7.), should be c. d in the Fail: चारके निरोद्धव्या, D. i.; (2) संयच्छति (यम्, c. l.) (=to c. tightly), c. d in irons: निगडसंयतः (ता, तं), Ra.; should c. her in the house: संयतां वासायेद्गृहम्, M.; (3) बध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9.) (=संयच्छति). Ph.: c. ed themselves to the boundaries of their divi-sions: प्रविभागसीमां न व्यतीयुः, R.: v. To transgress; to be c. d (i. e. in child-bed): आसन्नप्रसवा, P.
confinement: CONFINEMENT: I Restraint: q. v. II Impri--sonment: (1) निरोधः, -नम्, अव-; (2) बन्धनम् (c. by tying), putting in c.: बन्धने क्षिप्त्वा, D. i. III In childbirth: प्रसवावस्था (?).
confirm: CONFIRM: I To make firm: द्रढयति (nomi.) [Page143] or दृढीकरोति, to c. it still more: दृढतरीकर्तम्,: v. To establish. II To ratify: q. v. III To c. Christians: *प्रतिपादयति (c. of पद्).
confirmation: CONFIRMATION: I Establishment: q. v.: दृढीकरणम्। II Ratification: q. v. III Of Christians: *प्रतिपादनम्।
confirmatory: CONFIRMATORY: i. e. serving to confirm: expr. by verb.
confirmed: CONFIRMED (adj.): (1) दृढः (ढा, ढं): v. Firm; (2) स्थिरः (रा, रं): v. Constant.
confiscate: CONFISCATE: Ph.: the king should c. their pro-perty: निःस्वान् कारयेन्नृ पः; the whole property should be c. d: सर्वस्वहारमर्हन्ति, M. ix. 231. and 242.
confiscation: CONFISCATION: सर्वस्वहरणम्। and sim. comp. s.
conflagration: CONFLAGRATION: दाहः, c. of Tripura: त्रिपुरदाहः, Ki.: v. Burning. C. in a forest: दावानलः, Ki.
conflict: CONFLICT (subs.): I Contest: q. v.: विरोधः। II Opposition: (1) विरोधः, c. of two Smritis: स्मृत्योर्विरोधः, Y.; (1) विप्रतिषेधः, c. of the two duties: द्वयोः कार्ययोर्विप्रतिषेधः, Si. ii. 6.
CONFLICT (v.): v. To contend, clash. C. ing: विरुद्धः (द्धा, द्धं).
confluence: CONFLUENCE: I Of rivers: (1) सङ्गमः; (2) सम्भेदः, this is the c. of the two great rivers: अयमसौ महानद्योः सम्भेदः, Ma. iv.; (3) तोयव्यति-करः (poet), R. viii. 95. II Concourse: q. v.
conform: CONFORM: I Trans: v. To accommodate, suit. II Intrans.: v. To comply, obey.
conformable: CONFORMABLE: I Suitable, like: अनुरूपः (पा,  पं). II Compliant: अनुविधायिन् (f. नी).
conformably: CONFORMABLY: अनुसारेण: v. Accordance with, in.
conformation: CONFORMATION: I Agreement: q. v. II Form: q. v.: आकारः।
conformity: CONFORMITY: v. Agreement. In c. with: v. Accordace with, in.
confound: CONFOUND: I To mix and confuse: expr. by मन्यते (मन्, c. 4), c. s ignorance of distinc-tion as impartiality: अविशेषज्ञतापक्षपातित्वमिति  मन्यते, Ph.: c. ing, (lit. coupling) truth and falsehood: सत्यानृते मिथुनीकृत्य, S. II To per--plex: q. v.: आकुलीकरोति (कृ, c. 8.). Ph.: being c. ed: ससम्भ्रमम्, V. III. To ruin: q. v.: उच्छिनति (छिद्, c. 7).
confront: CONFRONT: I Lit.: (1) सम्मुखयति or अभिमुखयति (nomi.), to c. the Lord: ईशमभिमुखयितुम्, Ki.; (2) सम्मुखीकरोति or अभिमुखीकरोति, M. n. II To oppose: q. v.
confuse: CONFUSE: I To mix wrongly: सङ्किरति (क, c. 6): v. To mix. II To perplex: q. v.: आकुलीकरोति।
confusedly: CONFUSEDLY: I With bewilderment: ससम्भ्रमम्। II Without order: क्रमं विहाय।
confusion: CONFUSION: I Irregular mixture: सङ्करः, c. of castes: वर्णसङ्करः, Kal. II Tumult, disor--der: विप्लवः, when the duties prescribed by the Vedas and Smritis will be in a state of great c.: श्रौतस्मार्तधर्मे विप्लवमत्यन्तमुपगते, V. p. Ph.: in the c. (i. e. in the crowd): सङ्कुले, D. III Bewilder--ment: (1) सम्भ्रमः; (2) वैलक्ष्यम् (from shame), Ra. IV Ruin, defeat: q. v.
confute: CONFUTE: (1) खण्डयति (खण्ड्, c. 10.): v. To refute; (2) उत्तरं हरति (हृ, c. l.), Ki., or निरुत्तरीकरोति, M. n. (=to put to silence).
congeal: CONGEAL (v.): Trans.: घनीकरोति (कृ, c. 8.) II Intrans.: धनीमवति (भू, c. l.), c. ed snow; घनीभूतो हिमः, M. n.
congenial: CONGENIAL: I Kindred: एकप्रकृति (mfn.) (?). II Suitable: q. v.: अनुरूपः (पा, पं).
congenital: CONGENITAL: सहजः (जा, जं); expr. by जन्मन् (n.), c. blindness: जन्मान्धता।
congratulate: CONGRATULATE: अभिनन्दति (नन्द्, c. l.), c. d. [Page144] by the nuns: तापसीभिरभिनन्द्यमाना, Sa. N. B. Often expr. by दिष्टया (lit. by luck), I c. you on having such a boy as the gentle Rāma: दिष्टया वर्धसे यदीदृशस्ते वत्सो रामभद्रः, Vi.; we should c. ourselves that the king has returned to the city: दिष्टया राजा प्रतिनिवृत्तो नगरम्, V.
congratulation: CONGRATULATION: अभिनन्दनम् (?). To offer c.: v. To congratulate.
congregate: CONGREGATE: I Intrans: समागच्छति (गम्, c. l.): v. To assemble. II Trans: समाह-रति (हृ, c. l.): v. To collect.
congregation: CONGREGATION: I Collection: T. v.: समाहारः। II An assembly: v.: समाजः।
congruity: CONGRUITY: सङ्गतता। C. (of a sentence): आकाङ्क्षा, Ki.
conjecture: CONJECTURE (subs.): (1) वितर्कः, your c. is right: उपपन्नस्ते वितर्कः,; (2) ऊहः or ऊहा (=guess); (3) शङ्का (=apprehension); (4) अनुमानम् (= in--ference).

CONJECTURE (v.): (1) तर्कयति, वि- (तक्, c. 10) which do you c. (to be Śakuntalā): त्वं ताव-त्कतमां तर्कयसि, Sa. vi.; (2) ऊहते (ऊह्, c. 1), c. d that they were devoid of hostile feelings: औहिष्ट तान् वीतविरुद्धबुद्धीन्, B. iii. 48.
conjoin: CONJOIN: संयोजयति (युज्, c. 10): v. To join.
conjointly: CONJOINTLY: (1) expr. by adj., but c.: संहतास्तु, H.; (2) सम्भूय, all c.: सर्वे सम्भूय, Mat: v. Together.
conjugal: CONJUGAL: Ph.: c. love: दम्पत्योः प्रेम; transgression of c. duties: दम्पत्योः परस्परं धर्मव्यतिक्रमः, K. b.; c. fidelity: अव्यमिचारः, K. b.: v. Chastity.
conjugate: CONJUGATE (v): Ph.: c. भू in the लिट्। भूधातोर्लिट्-रूपाणि (n. pl.) ब्रूहि, वद, etc.: v. To say.
conjugation: CONJUGATION: I The act: धातुरूपाख्यानम्। II A class of verbs: गणः। III A scheme: धातुरूपादर्शः।
conjunction: CONJUNCTION: I Union: q. v. II In gram.: समुच्चयार्थकमव्ययम्। III In astro.: योगः, सं-, Planetary c.: ग्रहयोर्योगः, Su.
conjunctive: CONJUNCTIVE: I Connection: q. v. II Occasion: अवसरः।
conjuration: CONJURATION: I An entreaty: q. v. II En--chantment: q. v.: इन्द्रजालम्, to practise c. इन्द्रजालमाचरति, K. III Magic: q. v.
conjure: CONJURE (v. t.): I To adjure, implore: q. v. II To enchant: मोहयति (c. of मुह्), c. ing the king af Mālava by my c. ing art: इन्द्रजाल-विद्यया मालवेन्द्र मोहयन्, D. C. up: उत्थापयति (c. of स्था).
connect: CONNECT: सम्बध्नाति, अभि-, (rare) (बन्ध्, c. 9.), it is not an iota c. ed with its faults or merits: तत्कृतेन दोषेण गुणेन वाऽणुमात्रे णापि स न सभ्बध्यते, S.; c. ed with each other: इतरेतराभिसम्बद्धः (द्धा, द्धं), N. d.: v. To unite.
connection: CONNECTION, CONNEXION: (1) सभ्बन्धः (best equiv.), an enviable c.: श्लाध्यसम्बन्धः, R.; the c. between the families of Fanaka and Raghu जनकानाञ्च रघूणाञ्च सम्बन्धः, Vi.; (2) सम्पर्कः, to disallow c.: सम्पर्कम् नानुजानाति, Mal.; (3) सङ्गः (=being together), with your c.: सङ्गेन वः, Ku.: v. Association; (4) प्रबन्धः (=connec--tedness, as of a discourse), Ki.; (5) सङ्गमः (sp. sexual c.).
conquer: CONQUER: (1) जयति (जि, c. l.), to c. Persia: पारसिकान् जेतुम्, R. iv. 60; one who has c. ed his passions: जितेन्द्रियः, Ku.; (2) विजयते (जि, [Page145] c. l.), c. ed him in battle: युधि तं विजिग्ये, Vi.; (3) निर्जयति, अवजयति (rare), one who has c. ed the world: अवजितभुवनः, Ki.: v. To subdue, subjugate, surmount.
conquering: CONQUERING (adj.): जयिन्, विजयिन् (f. नी), c. power: विजयिवीर्यम्, Vi.
conqueror: CONQUEROR: (1) जेतृ, वि-, (rarely अव-,) (m.), c. of the (three) worlds: जगतां जेता, Vi.; (2) जित् (m.) in comp., c. of Indra: इन्द्रजित्।
conquest: CONQUEST: I The act: जयः, वि-: v. Victory, subjugation. II That which is conquered: expr. by जितः (ता तं).
conscientious: CONSCIENTIOUS: संज्ञानिन् (f. नी): v. Upright, just.
conscious: CONSCIOUS: I Possessing c. ness: चेतनः or सचेतनः (ना, नं), even by (those) who are not c.: विचेतनैरपि, Ku. II Aware, sensible: expr. by the verbs; जानाति (ज्ञा, c. 9.), वेत्ति (विद्, c. 2.), etc, (=to know: q. v.); though c. unable to control the organs: जानानाप्यप्रभवन्ती  करणानाम्, K.; which one can only be c. of: स्वसंवेद्यः (द्या, द्यं), K.
consciousness: CONSCIOUSNESS: I Sensation: चेतना or चैतन्यम्, deprived her of c.: तस्याश्चेतनां जहार, K.; (2) संज्ञा, to restore c.: संज्ञां ग्राहयति, K. II Know--ledge: (1) ज्ञानम्; (2) उपलब्धिः।
conscript: CONSCRIPT: I Sub.: v. Recruit. II Adj.: पत्रारोपितः (ता, तं).
conscription: CONSCRIPTION: बलसमुत्थानम्, D., and sim. comp. s.
consecrate: CONSECRATE: (1) प्रतिष्ठापयति (c. of स्था) (of idols, etc.), Mat., (2) पवित्रीकरोति or पवित्रयति (=to make sacred), will c. my language: मद्गिरं  पवित्रयिष्यति, N. i. 2.
consecration: CONSECRATION: (1) प्रतिष्ठापनम्, V. m.; (2) better by verb.
consecutive: CONSECUTIVE: expr. by adv.: अनुक्रमेण, for five c. years: अनुक्रमेण पञ्चवर्षम्।
consent: CONSENT (subs.): सम्मतिः, to obtain your c.: तव सम्मतिमधिगन्तुम्, N. ii. 48.; sells without the c. of the owner: स्वाम्यसम्मतो विक्रीणीते, M.
CONSENT (v.): (1) सम्मतिं ददाति (दा, c. 3.); (2) सम्मतः (ता, तं) भवति। Ph.: I c. to what has been written above: मतं मे यदत्रोपरि लेखितम्, Y.
consequence: CONSEQUENCE: I Result, effect: q. v.: फलम्, of evil c. s: अनिष्टफलः (ला, लं), Mu. Ph.: in c. of: v. For, account of, on; the c. of which was: ततः or अतः। II Logical: निगमनम्। III Importance. Ph.: of no c. निरर्थकः (का, कं); a matter of great c. गुर्वर्थः; doing what is of little c.: यत्किञ्चनकारिता, K.
consequent: CONSEQUENT (adj.): v. Attendant. C. upon: v. After.
CONSEQUENT (subs.): I Logic: निगमनम्। II Of rations: Perh. अन्तः।
consequential: CONSEQUENTIAL: I Lit.: आनुषङ्गिकः (की, कं). II Pompous, conceited: q. v.
consequentially: CONSEQUENTIALLY: I Logically: q. v. II Eventually: q. v. III In a regular series: अनुक्रमेण, पौर्वापर्येण। IV Pompously, concei--tedly: q. v.
consequently: CONSEQUENTLY: अतः, c. the behaviour of men is the same as of (lower) animals: अतः समानः  पश्वादिभिः पुरुषाणां व्यवहारः, S.: v. Therefore.
conservative: CONSERVATIVE (subs.): *नवविद्वेषिन् (f. णी); स्थितिपालः (ली, लं). C. ministry: *नवविद्वेषि-सचिवमण्डलम्।
conservator: CONSERVATOR: (1) रक्षकः; (2) पालः, in comp., c. of a forest: वनपालः: v. Preserver.
conserve: CONSERVE: I Verb: रक्षतिः v. To preserve. II Subs.: v. Preserve.
consider: CONSIDER: I In gen. sense: (1) विचारयति (c. of चर्), if it is c. ed, this quitting of life (by [Page146] widows) is selfish: अत्र हि विचार्यमाणे स्वार्थ एव  प्राणपरित्यागोऽयम्, K.; (2) विमृश(ष)ति (मृश्, or -ष्, c. 6), without c. ing sayings of Manu and others: मन्वादिवाक्यान्यविमृश्य, Da.; (3) आलोचयति, समा-, पर्या-, (लोच्, c. 10.), c. ing their (comparative) importance and insignifi-cance: तेषां गुरुलघुभावं पर्यालोच्य, K. b.; (4) चिन्त-यति, परि-, वि-। सं-, (चिन्त्, c. 10.) (to think of), c. ing the painfulness of affection: चिन्तयित्वा दुःखतां स्नेहस्य, K.; (5) समीक्षते (ईक्ष्, c. 1) (=to look at), age is not c. ed among elders in virtue: न धर्मवृद्धेषु वयः समीक्षते, Ku. II To regard, think: मन्यते (मन्, c. 4.), one who c. s himself learned: पण्डितम्मन्यः (न्या, न्यं), B.
considerable: CONSIDERABLE: I Respectable: q. v. II Moderately large: अनल्पः (ल्पा, ल्पं), a c. force: अनल्पं बलम्, D.: v. Many, large.
considerably: CONSIDERABLY: बलवत्, Sa.: v. Much, excee--dingly.
considerate: CONSIDERATE (adj.): I Mindful of the feel--lings or rights of others: no equiv: सदयः (या, यं) (=kind), enjoyed in a c. manner: सदयं बुभुजे, R. II Circumspect: समीक्ष्यकारिन् (f. णी); विमृष्यकारिन् (f. णी).
considerately: CONSIDERATELY: I With due regard to others: सदयम् (=kindly). II Circumspectly: (1) विमृश्य; (2) समीक्ष्य।
considerateness: CONSIDERATENESS: I Thoughtful kindness: दया (?). II Prudence: समीक्ष्यकारिता।
consideration: CONSIDERATION: I Deliberation: (1) विचारः or विचारणा, agreed without c अविचारानुमतः (ता,  तं), D. ii.; (2) आलोचना, सम-, परि-; (3) विमर्शः; (4) समीक्षा (=circumspection); (5) चिन्ता (=thinking). II Regard: आदरः। To have c. for: आद्रियते (दृ, c. 4.), has no c. for munificence: न त्यागमाद्रियते, K. In c. of: expr. by inde. past. part., in c. of its being the first (offence): प्रथममिति प्रेक्ष्य, Sa.: v. Account of, on. III Respectability: प्रतिष्ठा, of c.: लब्धप्रतिष्ठः (ष्ठा, ष्ठं): v. Chief. IV Motive, reason: q. v.: कारणम्। V. In law: अर्थः (?).
consign: CONSIGN: v. To entrust, deliver, send.
consist: CONSIST: I To subsist: q. v. II To be con--sistent: v. Consistent. III To c. of: Ph.: on what it stands and of what it c. s of यदाधारं  यदात्मकम्, V. p; the science of astronomy c. s of three branches ज्योतिःशास्त्रं स्कन्धत्रयाधिष्ठितम्, V. m.; the Gāyatri (metre) c. s of 24 syllables चतुर्विशत्यक्षरा गायत्री, Up.: v. C. ing of. IV To c. in.: Ph.: perspicuity c. s in clearness of meaning: अर्थवैमल्यात्मा प्रसादः, Kav.; grace c. s in picturesqueness of language: उक्तिवैचित्र्यरूपं  माधुर्यम्, Kav.
consisting of: CONSISTING OF: (1) -मयः (यी, यं), food c. of water, fruit and roots: जलफलमूलमयेष्वाहारेषु, K. Ph.: an army c. chiefly of elephants: हास्तिक-प्रायं सैन्यम्, Ra.; (2) आत्मकः (का, कं), in beings c. of five (elements) पञ्चात्मकेषु भूतेषु, B. p.; (3) in some cases by deriv., c. of five elements: पाञ्चमौतिकः (की, कं).
consistence: CONSISTENCE, CONSISTENCY: I Firmness, stability: q. v.: स्थैर्यम्। II Combination: q. v. III Congruity: साङ्गत्यम्। IV Thick--ness: q. v.
consistent: CONSISTENT: I Congruous: सङ्गतः (ता, तं). II Firm, solid: q. v.
consolable: CONSOLABLE: (1) आश्वासनीयः (या, यं); (2) शा (सा) न्त्वनीयः (या, यं).
consolation: CONSOLATION: (1) आश्वासः; (2) समाश्वासः; (3) शान्त्वनम् or सान्त्वनम्, -ना। To give c.: v. To console.
consolatory: CONSOLATORY: I Adj.: आश्वासकः (सिका, सकं); (2) शोकापनोदननिपुणः (णा, णं), K. II Subs.: सान्त्वनम्, उप-, with mild c. s: मृदुभिरुपसान्त्वनैः, K.
console: CONSOLE (v. t.): (1) आश्वासयति, सम्-, (c. of श्वस्), K.; (2) शा(सा)न्त्वयति, उप-, अभि-, (शान्त्व् or सान्त्व्, c. 10), B.; (2) अभ्युपपद्यते (पद्, c. 4), to c. Rali: रतिमभ्युपपत्तुम्, Ku. iv. 25; (3) प्रकृतौ स्थापयति (c. of स्था) (=to put in natural state), R.
consoler: CONSOLER: यः (या, यं) आश्वासयति: v. To console.
consolidate: CONSOLIDATE: (1) संहन्ति (हन्, c. 2.); (2) दृढी-करोति (=to make firm).
consonance: CONSONANCE: I Of sounds: साम्यम्। II Sui--table, consistent: q. v. योग्यता।
consonant: CONSONANT (adj.): I Accordant: समः (मा,  मं). II Suitable, consistent: q. v.
CONSONANT (subs.): (1) व्यञ्जनम् or व्यञ्जनवर्णम्; (2) हल् (according to the arrangement of Pāṇini), ending in a c.: हलन्त (f. न्ता).
consort: CONSORT (subs.): i. e. husband or wife: q. v.
conspicuous: CONSPICUOUS: I Manifest: q. v.: प्रकाशः or सुप्रकाशः (शा, शं). II Prominent, great: q. v.: उत्कृष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं).
conspicuousness: CONSPICUOUSNESS: I Lit.: प्रकाशता। II Emi--nence, renown: q. v.
conspire: CONSPIRE: (v.): I To plot: q. v.: उपजपति (जप्, c. l.). II To combine, agree: q. v.
constable: CONSTABLE: (1) रक्षिन् (m.) (watchman); (2) नागरिकः (=municipal c.?), D. ii. Lord high c.: *महादण्डनायकः।
constancy: CONSTANCY: I Firmness: (1) स्थैर्यम् or स्थिरता; (2) निश्चलता। II Of mind: स्थैयम्: v. Forti--tude, perseverance.
constant: CONSTANT: I Firm: (1) स्थिरः (रा, रं), my entire fortune is c.: स्थिरा मम सर्वसम्पत्, Si.; (2) अचलः or निश्चलः (ला, लं), regard for depen-dents is not c.: चलं गौरवमाश्रितेषु, Ku.; (3) अव-स्थितः or व्यवस्थितः (ता, तं) (rare), love for woman is not c.: प्रेम दयितास्वनवस्थितम्, Ku. iv. 28. II Continuous: q. v.: सततः (ता, तं).
constantly: CONSTANTLY I Firmly: (1) स्थिरम्; (2) अच-लम्। II Continuously, perpetually: q. v.: सततम्, think of truths c. in your mind: तत्त्वं  चिन्तय सततं चित्ते, J.
constellation: CONSTELLATION: राशिः, c. of the lion: सिंहराशिः।
constipate: CONSTIPATE: (1) बध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9); (2) अव-रुणद्धि (रुध्, c. 7.); (3) अवष्टभ्नाति, वि-, (स्तम्भ्, c. 9); (4) नह्यति, आ-, (नह्, c. 4.). N. B. These verbs take as their acc. मलम्, पुरीषम्, etc. C. ing: v. Costive (I).
constipation: CONSTIPATION: (1) बद्धविट्कता, and sim. comp. s, Sr.; (2) विष्टम्भः, Sr.
constituent: CONSTITUENT (adj.): Ph.: c. part: साधनम्: v. Element.
CONSTITUENT (subs.): I An elector: q. v. II A component: q. v.
constitute: CONSTITUTE: I To enact, establish: q. v. II To appoint, depute: q. v. III To form, compose. Ph.: after deciding what c. s a poem: काव्यस्वरूपं निरूप्य, Kav.; clearness of meaning c. s perspicuity: अर्थवैमल्यात्मा प्रसादः, Kav.; body or wealth does not c. manhood: न वपुर्वसु वा पुंस्त्वमूलम्, D.
constitution: CONSTITUTION: I Formation: q. v. II Natural condition, temperament: प्रकृतिः III Government: perh: तन्त्रम्।
constitutional: CONSTITUTIONAL: I Inherent in the consti--tution: स्वाभाविकः (की, कं). II Regulated by a c.: Ph.: c. government: *व्यवस्थिततन्त्रम्; c. law: *तन्त्रव्यवस्था।
constitutionally: CONSTITUTIONALLY: I Naturally: (1) प्रकृत्या; (2) स्वभावतः II Lawfully: q. v.
constrain: CONSTRAIN (v.): I To compel: q. v.: सम्पी-डयति (पीड्, c. 10.). II To restrain: q. v. III To compress: q. v.
constraint: CONSTRAINT: I Compulsion: q. v. II Res--traint: q. v.
constrict: CONSTRICT (v.): संकोचति (कुच्, c. l.): v. To contract.
construct: CONSTRUCT (v.): निर्मिमीते (मा, c. 3.): v. To build, make.
construction: CONSTRUCTION: I Making: निर्माणम्। II Form: q. v. III Of a sentence: (1) अन्वयः; (2) सम्बन्धः; (3) योजना। IV Sense, meaning: q. v. अर्थः।
constructive: CONSTRUCTIVE: Perh: फलार्थ, c. treason: फलार्थराजद्रोहः
construe: CONSTRUE (v.): I To explain the construc--tion of: अन्वयं वदति (वद्, c. l). To be c. d: (1) अन्वीयते (pass. of इ), Da.; (2) सम्बध्यते (pass of बन्ध्), why the word ‘so’ is not c. d with brother: तयापदं भ्रात्रैव कुतो न सम्बध्यते, Da. II To explain, interpret: q. v.
consul: CONSUL: I Ancient: *कंसलः; दण्डनायकः। II An agent of a foreign government: अनुदूतः।
consult: CONSULT: मन्त्रयति, -ते (मन्त्र्, c. 10.), c. my good: मन्त्रयध्वं हितं मम, Mah.; c. ed with the ministers: मन्त्रिमिः सार्धं मन्त्रयामास, V p.: v. Also, to consider; attend; ask.
consultation: CONSULTATION: (1) मन्त्रणा; (2) मन्त्रः; -णं, to hold c.: मन्त्रं करोति, P.: v. Consideration.
consume: CONSUME (v.): क्षपयति (c. of क्षिः): v. To destroy, waste.
consumer: CONSUMER: I Destroyer: q. v. II Dev--ourer: खादकः।
consummate: CONSUMMATE (v.): पूरयति (c. of पूर्): v. To complete.
consummation: CONSUMMATION: I Perfection: q. v.: परिपाकः, seeing his c. in civility: वीक्ष्य तस्य विनये परि-पाकम्, N. II Close, end: q. v.
consumption: CONSUMPTION: I Decay, destruction: q. v. क्षयः। II Of commodities: perh. best expr. by विक्रयः (=sale). III A disease: (1) क्षयरोगः; (2) यक्ष्मन् or राजयक्ष्मन् (m.); (3) शोषः।
contact: CONTACT: Lit.: स्पर्शः। II Association: q. v.: सम्पर्कः।
contagion: CONTAGION: I Contact: स्पर्शः। II Infection by c.: स्पर्शसञ्चारः।
contagious: CONTAGIOUS: Ph.: c. disease आमयः स्पर्शसञ्चारी, Raj.
contain: CONTAIN (v.): I To comprise: (1) by bah. comp., a dwelling c. ing eight courts: अष्टप्रकोष्ठं  भवनम्, Mr.: v. Having; (2) by गर्भः (र्भा,  र्मं) in comp., this house c. s men: पुरुषगर्भमेतद्  गृहम्, Mu.; c. ing moral instruction: धर्मोपदेश-गर्भः (र्भा, र्भं), K.: v. Also, to hold, include. Ph.: I saw that it c. ed this couplet (lit. written on it) तस्यामिभामभिलिखितामार्यामपश्यम्, K. II To restrain: q. v.
contaminate: CONTAMINATE: दूषयति (c. of दुष्): v. To pollute.
contemn: CONTEMN: अवमन्यते (मन्, c. 4): v. To despise.
contemplate: CONTEMPLATE: I Trans.: v. To consider. II Intrans: ध्यायति (ध्यै, c. l).: v. To meditate.
contemplation: CONTEMPLATION: (1) चिन्ता: v. Considera--tion; (2) ध्यानम्: v. Meditation. To have in c.: i. e. to intend or purpose: q. v.
contemporaneous: CONTEMPORANEOUS, CONTEMPORARY: (1) समकालः (ला, लं); (2) समकालीनः (ना, नं); (3) तुल्यकालः (ला, लं), these kings will be c.: एते  तुल्यकाला भूभृतो भविष्यन्ति, V. p.
contempt: CONTEMPT: (1) अवज्ञा, was turned out with c.: अवज्ञया निःसारितः, P.: (2) अवमानम्, c. of each other: अन्योन्यावमानम्, D.; (3) अनादरः, Ki.; (4) अवगणना, M. n. Ph.: to treat with c.: अवजानाति (ज्ञा, c. 9.): v. To despise.
contemptible: CONTEMPTIBLE: (1) निकृष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं): v. Mean; (2) गर्हितः (ता, तं): v. Despicable.
contemptuously: CONTEMPTUOUSLY: (1) अवज्ञया; (2) सावज्ञम्; (3) सावमानम्, (4) अनादेरण; (5) अवगणनया।
contend: CONTEND: (1) विगृह्णाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.) (=to contest), c. ing with the enemy of Namuchi (i. e. Indra): नमुचिद्विषा विगृह्य, Si. i. 51.; (2) विरुणद्धि (रुध्, c. 7.): v. To oppose; (3) विवदते (वद्, c. l.): v. To dispute. (4) स्पर्धते (स्पर्ध्, c. l.): v. To ire.
contending: CONTENDING (part. adj.): विवदमानः (ना, नं); better expr. by verb.
content: CONTENT (adj.): (1) सन्तुष्टः or तुष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं); (2) सन्तोषवत् (f. ती) (rare), P. Ph.: you should be c.: त्वया सन्तोषः कार्यः, P. ii. 6.
CONTENT, TO BE: तुष्यति, सं-, (तुष्, c. 4.), an intelligent man is c. with whatever is his own: यस्य यावत् स तेनैव स्वेन तुष्यति वुद्धिमान्, V. p.
CONTENT (v. t.): सन्तोषयति (c. of तुष्): v. To satisfy, please.

CONTENT (subs.): I Contentment: q. v. II Reward: q. v.: पारितोषिकम्। III Capacity: q. v.: the cubic c. s of a sphere: गोलस्यान्तर्गतं  घनफलम्, Li. IV That which is contained: Ph.: the c. s of a book: यद्ग्रन्थे लिखितम्; table of c. s: निर्धण्टपत्रम् or सूचिपत्रम्, Maheshachandra.
contentedly: CONTENTEDLY: expr. by the adj.: सन्तुष्टः (ष्टा,  ष्टं).
contention: CONTENTION: I Contest, strife: q. v.: विवादः। II Controversy: q. v.: विवादः, Da. Ph.: your c. is not valid: *न सङ्गतस्ते वादः। III Ea--gerness: q. v.: Ph.: “c. of mind”: मनः-संयोगः।
contentious: CONTENTIOUS: बिवादप्रियः (या यं): v. Quar--relsome, litigious.
contentment: CONTENTMENT: सन्तोषः, there is no wealth like c.: सन्तोषतुल्यं धनमस्ति नान्यत्, P. ii. 6.
conterminous: CONTERMINOUS: एकसीमः (मा, मं) or by cir--cum.: v. Border.
contest: CONTEST (subs.): I Dispute: q. v.: विवादः II Strife: विग्रहः, a furious c.: तुमुलो विग्रहः, Mat.
CONTEST (v.): I To dispute: q. v. II To contend, fight: q. v.: विगृह्णाति (ग्रह्, c. 9).
contested: CONTESTED: expr. by विवाद in comp.: v. Disputed.
contiguous: CONTIGUOUS (1) संलग्नः (ग्ना, ग्नं) (=adjoin--ing): (2) सन्निकृष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं) (=adjacent: q. v.).
continence: CONTINENCE: (1) संयमः; (2) संयमिता; (3) जिते-न्द्रियता, -त्वं; (4) इन्द्रियजयः, K.
continent: CONTINENT (adj.): I Chaste: (1) सयमिन् (f. नी); (2) जितेन्द्रियः (या, यं). II Continu--ous: q. v.
CONTINENT (subs.): I Lit.: वर्षः (?), V. p. II Europe as distinguished from England: *इयुरुपवर्षः।
continental: CONTINENTAL: I Lit.: *वर्षीयः (या, यं) or वर्ष in comp., c. congress: *वर्षसभा। II Of Europe: expr. by comp., c. tour: इयुरुपवर्षभ्रमणम्।
contingence: CONTINGENCE, CONTINGENCY: I Possibility: सम्भावना। II A casualty: expr. by words meaning uncertain, doubtful: follows c. s. अध्रुवाणि निषेवते, H.; even if his connection was a c.: सन्दिग्धोऽप्यस्य समागमो यदि स्यात्, K.
contingent: CONTINGENT (adj.): (1) अनिशिचतः (ता, तं) (=uncertain); (2) सन्दिग्धः (ग्धा, ग्धं) (=doubtful), c. on: आयत्तः (त्ता, त्तं); c. on fate: दैवायत्तः (त्ता, त्तं), Ve.: v. To depend (II.).
continual: CONTINUAL: (1) नित्यः (त्या, त्यं) (prep=per--petual); (2) अविरतः (ता, तं): v. Incess--ant; (3) अविच्छिन्नः (न्ना, न्नं): v. Uninter--rupted.
continually: CONTINUALLY: (1) सततम्, in c. passing time: काले सततयायिनि, V. s.; v. Always: (2) अवि-रतम्: v. Incessantly; (3) मुहुर्मुहुः: v. Fre--quently.
continuance: CONTINUANCE: I Constancy, stay: q. v.: स्थितिः, अव-। II Continuity: q. v. Ph.: of long c. बहुकालस्थायिन् (f. नी).
continuation: CONTINUATION: I The act of continuing: expr. by circum.: v. To continue. II Continuity: q. v. III That which is con--tinued, as the c. of a story: शेषः: v. Remainder, sequel.
continue: CONTINUE (v. i.): I To stay: q. v.: तिष्ठति,  अव-, (स्था, c. l). II To last: q. v. III To persevere: तिष्ठति, अव-,।

CONTINUE (v. t.): expr. by adv., or by not and cease, by c. d calls: नित्यविहितोपहूतिषु, Si.; c. d to quarrel: कलहं कुर्वाणा न विश्राम्यति, P.; and c. d the journey day and night: दिवारात्रौ  चावहत्, K.
continuity: CONTINUITY: (1) प्रसक्तिः: (2) प्रबन्धः, c. of making sacrifices: अध्वराणां क्रियाप्रबन्धः, R.; (3) अविच्छेदः (=uninterruptedness); (4) अविरामः (=unceasingness); (5) सातत्यम् (=perpetuity).
continuous: CONTINUOUS: (1) प्रसक्तः (f. क्ता), by c. perfor-mance: अविच्छिन्नादनुष्ठानात्, M. n.; (3) अविरतः (ता, तं): v. Incessant.
continuously: CONTINUOUSLY: (1) सततं or सन्ततम्, Ki.; (2) अविच्छिन्नम्; (3) अविरतम्; (4) प्रसक्तम्।
contraband: CONTRABAND: निषिद्धः or प्रतिषिद्धः (द्धा, द्धं), K. b.
contract: CONTRACT (v. t.): (I) To bring into less com--pass: (1) संकोचति (कुच्, c. l.) or संकोचं नयति (नी, c. l.), प्रापयति (c. of आप्), etc.; (2) कुञ्चयति, आ-, वि-, (c. of कुञ्च्); (3) संक्षिपति (क्षिप्, c. 6.) (=to shorten); (4) समूहति (ऊह्, c. l.) (=to bring together), as if c. ing the quarters: दिशः समूहन्निव, Ki. II To acquire, gain: q. v.: अधिगच्छति (गम्, c. l.). III In gram. संक्षिपति (?). Miscel: to c. a debt: ऋणं  करोति, a debt c. ed by a husband: पतिकृतमृणम्, N. s.; to c. a disease: व्याधिम् अधिगच्छति (गम्, c. l.), अवाप्नोति (आप्, c. 5.), etc. Sr.; I will c. the union of Madalekhā with Vaiśampāyana: वैशम्पायनस्य मदलेखया सह घटनां कारयामि, K.; to c. friendship: सख्यं बध्नाति, Ku.

CONTRACT (v. i.): I To shrink: (1) संकुचति (कुच्, c. 6.), skin c. s: संकुचति चर्म, V. d; (2) कुञ्चति, वि-, आ-, (कुञ्च्, c. l.), with the brow c. ed: विकुञ्चितभ्रूलतम्, Ku. v. 74; (3) संकोचम् एति, व्रजति, etc. II To covenant: (1) समयं or संविदं करोति; (2) (अभ्युपैति (इ, c. 2.) (=to agree), c. ing for service: शुश्रूषामभ्युपेत्य, Vri.; Ph.: should reside the time c. ed for: कृतं कालं निवसेत्, Y.; should complete the time c. ed for: कृतं कालं  समापयेत्, N. s.
CONTRACT (subs,): I Lit.: (1) नियमः; (2) समयः; (3) संविद्, -दा (f.), breach of c.: संविद्-व्यतिक्रमः, M. II A contracted word: संक्षिप्त-पदम् (?).
contractible: CONTRACTIBLE, CONTRACTILE: (1) संकोचशीलः (ला, लं); (2) कुञ्चनीयः (या, यं) (rare).
contraction: CONTRACTION: I Lit.: (1) संकोचः, -नम्; (2) कुञ्चनम्, वि-, आ-, II An abbreviation: संक्षेपः।
contradict: CONTRADICT: (1) वि- रुणद्धि (रुध्, c. 7.), प्रति-,  उप-, (=to oppose), S.; (2) प्रतिषेधति (सिध्, c. l.), (= I), he would c. the variety of the world: स जगद्वैचित्र्यं प्रतिषेधेत्, S. iii. 33.; (3) प्रत्याख्याति (ख्या, c. 2.) (=gainsay): v. To deny. To c. a man: expr. by circum, he c. ed himself on many points: *स बहुनि विरुद्ध-वचनान्युवाच।
contradictory: CONTRADICTORY: I Opposing in terms: (1) विरुद्धः (द्धा, द्धं); (2) विरोधिन् (f. नी), these two assertions are c.: परस्परविरोधिनी वचने, Mu. i. II Repugnant, inconsistent: q. v.
